ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of "Contributing to Society through Healthcare" by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Windows Software Manager is responsible for leading the design and development of software at OrganOx, for device-hosted applications and services running on Windows-based platforms, ensuring delivery of robust, high-quality solutions for regulated medical environments. The role combines deep technical expertise developing Graphical User Interfaces (GUI), connectivity solutions and implementing cybersecurity mitigations, with strong leadership of teams, projects and cross-functional stakeholders.

Operating with a system-level perspective, the Windows Software Manager takes end-to-end ownership of the application software, driving alignment with quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. The role also serves as a key technical representative for OrganOx, engaging confidently with external stakeholders including regulatory bodies, partners, and customers.

This is an on-site role in Oxford with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Windows Software Manager will be responsible for:

Resource management

Lead and manage a team of Windows software engineers, fostering a high-performance culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence
Providing line management, including goal setting, performance reviews, development planning, and ongoing coaching
Mentor and support engineers in low-level design, debugging, and real-time system development challenges
Define and maintain an effective team structure, including roles, responsibilities, operating mechanisms, and supporting infrastructure
Plan and manage resource allocation, including headcount planning, role definition, workload distribution, and optimisation of team utilisation across distributed teams.
Oversee recruitment activities, including identifying hiring needs, interviewing, candidate evaluation, hiring recommendations, onboarding, and probation management.
Maintain visibility of team capabilities (knowledge, skills, and abilities) and develop targeted training and development plans to address gaps and enhance performance.
Facilitate clear and effective communication within the team and across stakeholders, ensuring alignment with wider organisational objectives.

Planning

Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
Guide technical decisions, design reviews
Ensure robust software integration with cross-functional teams
Drive Agile or hybrid Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices
Author and execute a roadmap of developments to improve the Software Engineering function, with emphasis on application-level software
Financial forecasting and spend tracking against approved department and project budgets

Technical Oversight & Execution

Provide technical leadership for the development of application-level software for Class II and Class III medical devices.
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory standards and frameworks, including FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and other relevant safety standards.
Establish and enforce high-quality software engineering practices, including code reviews, architectural governance, and design best practices.
Contribute hands-on expertise in complex or critical technical areas when required.
Drive design principles that support modularity, testability, maintainability, scalability
Oversee release quality, defect management, and continuous improvement initiatives

Process and tools

SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Work Instructions supporting Software Engineering
Selection, development, and qualification of Software Engineering tools and systems.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software and medical device development.
Continuously improve development processes, tools, and engineering practices
Drive innovation in IoMT-enabled medical devices, ensuring seamless integration with cloud and connected systems.
Introduce automation, performance optimisation, and data-driven analytics.
Oversee and approve Software Engineering Design History Files (DHF)
Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx's Code of Conduct and all other company policies

Requirements

Skills & Experience

Proven track record in the development, release, and maintenance of Class II/III medical device software or similarly safety-critical systems.
Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including agile methodologies and comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration)
Proven understanding of edge-to-cloud architectures
Solid experience designing OTA update mechanisms, including safe update strategies (e.g. rollback, validation, compatibility)
Strong working knowledge and application of messaging technologies (e.g. Azure IoT Hub, MQTT, AMQP).
Solid expertise in C#, C++ and .net framework
Familiar with Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) concepts (task scheduling, interrupts, concurrency) and Board Support Package (BSP).
Familiarity with Unified Modelling Language (UML) and object-oriented design principles
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a collaborative leadership approach
Strong systems-thinking capability, with the ability to view and optimise across software layers under real-world constraints
Proven problem-solving skills, including proactive identification and mitigation of technical risks.
Experience with model-based and model-driven development, and simulation tools to accelerate development and testing. Strong expertise in IoMT technologies and cloud-based system integration.
Comprehensive knowledge of regulatory standards and frameworks, including IEC 62304, ISO 14971, FDA guidance, ISO 13485 and ISO 62366.
Ability to tailor compliance approaches while maintaining focus on risk, cybersecurity, scalability, maintainability and reliability
Proven experience managing external technical partners and ensuring quality deliverables across the full product lifecycle
Track record of driving process improvements to enhance efficiency, compliance, and product quality
Skilled in both developing innovative solutions and maintaining existing products in line with QMS (Quality Management System) and industry standards.
Highly effective in applying problem-solving techniques (e.g. brainstorming, 5-whys, fishbone), supported by demonstrable structured and rigorous approach to define activities and achieve tangible deliverables with limited supervision
An effective communicator, who readily engages in a timely and proactive manner
Passion for innovation and commitment to developing medical devices that improve patient outcomes

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Intelligent Document Processing
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.
Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.
Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.
Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.
Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.
Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.
Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.
Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

What You'll Bring To The Team

A solid track record (5+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.
Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.
Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.
Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.
Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.
An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.
A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.
Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.
Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.
An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.
You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

We are looking for senior software engineers who can also be people managers of other software engineers, for a share of their time (up to 50%).

On the software engineering part:

More than knowledge of a specific language or framework, we are looking for great software engineering skills:

ability to translate functional requirements into an elegant and simple design, and then deliver the code.

We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end users.

On the people management part, here is what it entails:

coaching up to 6 direct reports (usually every 2 weeks)
defining expectations, collecting and delivering feedback
building career development plans (we have a skill leveling matrix)
participating in performance-related decisions with other managers (ex: proposing and calibrating salary raises), including under-performance remediation
(optional) leading ad hoc projects with other managers to structure engineering (ex: organize technical demos, animate an All Hands, lead evolutions to our skill leveling matrix)

In the Pigment engineering team, people managers do not have the responsibility of a particular technical domain, as this is the role of technical leads: this way, we make sure career decisions and technical choices are independent from one another.

Explore Our Tech Blog:

If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!

Who you are

In any case, you have:

Experience as a software engineer working on a product in production - for managers specifically, this experience must be evaluated during the interview process at a “senior” level (that is, usually from 7-8 years)
Experience in people management of at least 2-3 years,
Proven experience designing object oriented software with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, Python or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive)
Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude
A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!)
A fluent level of English (French is not a must)

What you will get

Competitive salary
Equity
The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 💙
Trust and flexible working hours
Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York and, Toronto
Remote-friendly environment

You will be responsible for assessing complex existing application and integration landscapes, particularly Microsoft technology-based estates, identifying modernization opportunities, and designing scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable and cloud-agnostic target solutions aligned to business capabilities and enterprise architecture standards.
You will bring strong functional understanding and technical depth to translate business workflows, operating processes, integration dependencies, data flows, control points, reporting requirements and non-functional needs into practical modernization blueprints. The role involves defining migration-ready architecture patterns across .NET, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure and related Microsoft-based technologies, evaluating technology options, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring solutions address scalability, availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO, security, auditability, observability, operational resilience and long-term supportability.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Solution Architecture
Application Legacy Modernization
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Microservices
Kafka / Event-Driven Architecture
Kubernetes
API & Integration Modernization
HA/DR design
DevSecOps / GitOps

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Capital Markets domain experience
DORA / operational resilience awareness

Key Competencies:

Strong enterprise solution architecture experience in large-scale legacy modernization, application transformation, distributed systems, financial services platforms or high-volume transaction processing environments.
Ability to assess legacy estates including monolithic applications, tightly coupled integrations, shared databases, batch workflows, reporting platforms, operational bottlenecks and technology obsolescence risks.
Ability to understand business capabilities, functional workflows, operating models, reporting needs, controls, data dependencies and user journeys, and translate them into executable modernization solutions.
Deep understanding of microservices, domain-driven design, API design, database-per-service, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging and enterprise integration design patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, IBM MQ, REST, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, message transformation, replayability, retry, exception handling and reconciliation patterns.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, secrets management and DevSecOps engineering practices.
Good working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP cloud services, cloud landing zones, networking, identity, security, observability, resilience and workload deployment patterns.
Hands-on exposure to Azure architecture and Microsoft-based modernization patterns, including App Services, AKS, Azure SQL or SQL Server modernization, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and secure enterprise deployment practices.
Knowledge of cloud-agnostic architecture principles, multi-cloud deployment considerations, workload portability, exit strategy, high availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO definition and cross-environment resilience patterns.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platform concepts such as batch and streaming data flows, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance and regulatory data controls will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of Microsoft application landscapes including .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, stored procedures, SSIS/SSRS awareness, Azure services, PostgreSQL, Redis, relational modelling, reporting platforms and approaches for modernizing legacy enterprise applications.
Experience defining migration approaches such as strangler pattern, phased cutover, parallel run, dual operation, output reconciliation, rollback design, hyper-care and legacy decommissioning.

Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner

Understand business processes, user journeys, data flows, upstream/downstream dependencies, reporting needs, control requirements and operational pain points to shape fit-for-purpose enterprise solution designs.
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into modernization roadmaps, architecture decisions, solution blueprints, integration patterns, service boundaries, data models, deployment views and implementation guidance.
Architect enterprise-grade application solutions using microservices, domain-aligned service design, API-first integration, event-driven workflows, service-owned databases and containerized runtime models.
Design enterprise integration solutions using Kafka, IBM MQ, REST APIs, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, canonical events, adapters, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling and reconciliation patterns.
Architect cloud-native and platform-agnostic solutions using Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, AKS/GKE or equivalent platforms, with appropriate runtime, networking, secrets, identity, deployment and portability considerations.
Provide Azure-focused architecture guidance including Azure landing zones, compute, networking, identity, security, monitoring, deployment, integration and migration patterns for enterprise application modernization.

Assess and document non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, latency, availability, resilience, disaster recovery, failover, security, auditability, monitoring and operational support.

Support phased modernization planning including strangler pattern, coexistence with legacy systems, parallel run, data reconciliation, cutover readiness, rollback planning, risk mitigation and legacy decommissioning considerations.

About the Role

This role is responsible for architecture assessment, target-state definition, and modernization alignment for complex enterprise application landscapes undergoing legacy transformation. You will focus on shaping scalable, resilient, secure, and governable architectures that progressively move monolithic, tightly coupled, batch-oriented systems toward modular, event-driven, cloud-enabled and operationally observable platforms.

The role requires strong hands-on architecture depth across application modernization, integration architecture, microservices, APIs, event streaming, container platforms, database modernization, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and governance. You will collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, operations, and delivery teams to define transition roadmaps, manage architectural risks, establish guardrails, validate implementation choices, and ensure modernization is delivered through controlled, incremental, and enterprise-grade transformation practices.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Architecture
Legacy Modernization
Application Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
API & Integration Architecture
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Domain-Driven Design
Strangler Pattern Migration
DevSecOps
CI/CD & IaC
Observability
DataBricks
Data Governance & Lineage
Cloud Portability
Kubernetes
Kafka
.NET
MSSQL / PostgreSQL

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Banking Domain experience

Key Competencies:

Proven enterprise architecture experience across large-scale legacy modernization, distributed systems, integration platforms, database ecosystems, cloud-enabled platforms, and regulated enterprise environments.
Strong ability to assess monolithic, tightly coupled, database-centric and batch-driven estates and translate findings into practical target-state architecture and migration roadmaps.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, service decomposition, database-per-service patterns, distributed workflows, sagas, APIs, and contract-first design.
Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, Kafka-based event streaming, schema management, asynchronous processing, replayability, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and integration resilience patterns.
Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft .NET ecosystems, REST / gRPC APIs, middleware platforms, enterprise messaging, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and application modernization technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-agnostic and hybrid architecture principles including Kubernetes, Docker, containerized deployment, cloud portability, platform engineering, and workload isolation.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated quality gates, release orchestration, environment promotion, vulnerability scanning, and audit-ready change management.
Ability to define resilience and operational readiness requirements including high availability, disaster recovery, failover, observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, SLOs, incident handling, and support transition.
Good appreciation of enterprise data platforms like Databricks , governed reporting, data lineage, data quality, auditability, regulatory evidence, and interaction between operational systems and analytical data platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, decision facilitation, risk articulation, technical communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Ability to balance target-state architecture ambition with delivery pragmatism, coexistence constraints, incremental migration, business continuity, operational stability, and regulatory expectations.
Strong documentation discipline across architecture blueprints, transition states, decision records, integration contracts, dependency maps, runbooks, governance artifacts, and executive-level architecture narratives.

Certifications (Preferred):

TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner / TOGAF® 9 Certified
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

What You Will Do

Own enterprise architecture assessment and target-state definition for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives across application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and operations domains.
Assess current-state monolithic applications, shared database dependencies, batch processing models, middleware integrations, reporting dependencies, operational constraints, and resiliency gaps to define pragmatic modernization pathways.
Define future-state architecture aligned to separation of concerns, microservices, database-per-service, API-led integration, event-driven processing, cloud portability, automated delivery, observability, and enterprise governance principles.
Establish architecture guardrails, reference patterns, decision records, integration standards, data ownership principles, service boundary guidance, and non-functional requirements for scalable and resilient modernization delivery.
Guide decomposition of tightly coupled legacy capabilities into domain-aligned services, reusable platform components, controlled interfaces, independently deployable modules, and governed operational workflows.
Support migration strategy using incremental modernization patterns such as strangler migration, parallel run, coexistence, controlled cutover, rollback planning, reconciliation, and phased capability transition.
Provide architecture direction for integration modernization across messaging, APIs, file-based interfaces, event streaming, schema governance, idempotent processing, error handling, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
Partner with data architecture teams to align application modernization with governed data platforms, lineage, auditability, data quality, reporting readiness, and operational data consumption patterns.
Drive architecture alignment across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment models including Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and environment readiness.
Define and validate resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, failover, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, operational readiness, and supportability requirements for business-critical enterprise platforms.
Facilitate architecture governance forums, technical design reviews, solution walkthroughs, migration readiness assessments, risk reviews, and cross-team decision-making across delivery workstreams.
Support implementation oversight during build, test, deployment, cutover, stabilization, and hyper-care phases to ensure solutions remain aligned with enterprise architecture guardrails and modernization objectives.
Create and maintain architecture documentation including current-state assessments, target-state blueprints, transition architectures, integration views, dependency maps, decision logs, operational runbooks, and modernization roadmaps.

Why Join Us

At Acuity Analytics, you'll have the opportunity to work across complex enterprise Azure environments while helping shape and improve our Managed Services capability.

You'll solve challenging technical problems, influence standards and automation, mentor other engineers, and work closely with customers and technical teams.

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

About the job

Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations – Cardiff, Glasgow, or London. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow. (20% hybrid, 1 day per week)

Job summary

Across government, cloud technology underpins the delivery of secure, scalable and modern digital services. As organisations adopt cloud-first strategies, strong architecture is essential to ensure platforms are well-designed, governed and able to deliver long-term value. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.

As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision-making and support delivery teams to build high-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

This is a highly influential technical role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, requiring deep Azure expertise and strong architectural capability.

Job description

You will be responsible for:

Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance
Providing oversight and assurance for complex cloud solutions
Supporting architectural decision-making and managing technical risk
Promoting reusable frameworks and best practice across teams
Collaborating with stakeholders to align technology and business needs
Evaluating emerging Azure capabilities and supporting their adoption
Mentoring architects and engineers, building capability across DDSS

We are looking for:

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.
You may come from a infrastructure, cloud, enterprise or platform background, but you will demonstrate:

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision-making
Knowledge of security, identity and compliance in cloud environments
Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Relevant certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is expected (or achievable).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps or regulated environments is beneficial.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Ofgem’s architecture capability and Azure cloud platform. You will help ensure systems are secure, scalable and fit for the future, supporting digital transformation and services that impact consumers across Great Britain.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Extensive experience in design and delivery of complex solutions on Microsoft Azure (Lead Criteria).

Demonstrable proficiency in technical direction, team mentorship, and guidance across multi-disciplinary IT teams and architects (Lead Criteria).

Understanding Azure security frameworks, compliance standards, and identity management models.
Proven capability in the definition and implementation of governance models for cloud adoption and optimisation.
Proficiency in architectural modelling tools such as Archi and frameworks, such as ArchiMate, UML, or equivalent, with the ability to create and maintain architectural artefacts.

Holds or can obtain the following certifications or equivalent:

Formal Architectural Qualification such as BCS EA Certification or equivalent.
Cloud Architecture Certification: Microsoft Azure Solution Architect (Expert).

Desirable Criteria

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices.
Understanding government digital standards and assurance processes.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Seeing the Big Picture
Making Effective Decisions
Leadership

Technical skills

You will also be asked to prepare a presentation. Full details of the presentation will be included in the invitation to interview.

Benefits
Alongside your salary of £63,443, OFGEM contributes £18,379 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

When you press the ‘Apply now’ button, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.
You will then be asked to provide a 1250 word ‘personal statement’ evidencing how you meet the essential and desirable skills and capabilities listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. You must ensure that any evidence submitted as part of your application or used during interview, including your CV and any statements or examples, are truthful and factually accurate. Ofgem takes any incidences of cheating very seriously. Please ensure all examples provided are of your own experience. Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant applications will be withdrawn from the process. Please note that plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own.

Please refer to Civil Service candidate advice on the acceptable use of artificial intelligence within the recruitment and selection process - Artificial intelligence and recruitment , Civil Service Careers

If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by [ https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn ].

At Ofgem, we expect our staff to carry out their roles with honesty, fairness and openness. They should follow the Civil Service code and be free from any influence or bias. We are committed to making sure interests are recognised, declared and managed appropriately so that we can fulfil our duties as an energy regulator. Our Conflicts of Interest policy outlines the types of interests Ofgem staff must declare before onboarding, and the rules they must follow throughout employment so that we can clearly demonstrate that our decisions are not influenced by private interests.

Shape What Happens Next. Be Part Of Something Bigger.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Web Developer to help lead the continuous development and ongoing support of the University's central web services, principally the Web Publishing Platform (EdWeb 2) — the open-source, Drupal-based service behind nearly 170 environments and over 600 subsites, curated by more than 1,200 editors and reaching around 30 million users a year from across the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 
The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 

What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 

What You Will Work On:

Technical Leadership 

Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
Experience writing performance software in Rust
Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

About Spire

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors.

You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth.

We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique.

We Offer

Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme
More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are seeking IT Architects to lead the design and implementation of hybrid cloud application modernisation projects with our Public Sector clients. You will provide technical leadership for migrating existing applications to cloud and for building new cloud native solutions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Providing, architectural, consultative and engineering support for our customers’ journeys to the cloud
Bringing industry insight to deliver innovative solutions, that are tailored to the specific needs of our customers
Leadership for transformations of enterprise complex projects, from system requirements through delivery and production/deployment, providing architectural and hands-on technical leadership to ensure overall solution integrity
Building strong relationships with our clients and acting as a trusted advisor

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

You will be familiar with AWS or/and Azure and be comfortable with Microservice architectures and a range of cloud, devops and integration technologies. You will have worked on hybrid cloud complex systems integration projects designing elements of the target cloud solution and its integration with existing on-premise applications.

You will be comfortable working in ‘rainbow’ teams with multiple different suppliers or as part of a wholly IBM team. Your background is likely to be a mix of large-scale waterfall deliveries and more agile projects. You will be a hands-on professional with a proven track-record in keeping your skills up to date, ideally evidenced through recognized certifications.

Proficiency in designing and implementing hybrid cloud solutions combining on-premises and cloud-based services.

Experience in creating architecture diagrams component models and technology stacks for hybrid environments.

Deep understanding of major cloud providers (e.g. AWS Azure Google Cloud) and their respective services.

Familiarity with cloud-native services serverless computing and managed services.

Experience in designing managing and optimizing on-premises infrastructure including virtualization storage and networking.

Knowledge of on-premises automation tools (e.g. Ansible Puppet Chef).

Proficiency in designing and implementing secure connectivity solutions (e.g. VPNs Direct Connect VPN Gateways).

Experience in integrating on-premi

Public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes etc.)
Strong understanding & delivery experience of cloud native architectures
Extensive experience using agile delivery methods, i.e. Scrum
Good understanding of scaled agile delivery methods, i.e. SAFe or LeSS

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV).

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Good knowledge of system design & delivery
Java & JavaScript frameworks eg Spring Boot, React, Angular, J2EE
Enterprise integration technologies (Kafka, MQ, IBM Streams, ESBs, ETL etc)
Enterprise level persistence technologies (Oracle, Postgres, DB2, NoSQL, Redis, Graph etc.)
Estimation experience (top down, bottom up, planning poker etc.)
Experienced in architectural languages or frameworks e.g. UML, Zachman, TOGAF
Understanding of Automation in the development, testing and operations context.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior .NET Developer with deep experience in Azure cloud services and Azure DevOps to lead the design and delivery of scalable, secure, cloud-native applications. This role will have significant technical ownership, contribute to architecture and engineering standards, and mentor other developers while working closely with product and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and delivery of complex applications using .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET 6+/Core).
Architect and implement cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Services, Functions, AKS, Service Bus, SQL, Storage, Key Vault).
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps; promote DevOps best practices across teams.
Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, reliability, and observability.
Lead troubleshooting of complex production issues and drive root cause analysis and remediation.
Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers; contribute to hiring and onboarding.
Continuously improve engineering practices, tooling, and delivery processes.

Required Qualifications

6+ years of professional experience in .NET development (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core/.NET).
Proven experience designing and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (repos, pipelines, releases, work item integration).
Solid experience with distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (Azure SQL/SQL Server) and data access patterns (Entity Framework, Dapper).
Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices (SOLID, clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD).
Experience leading technical initiatives or acting as a technical owner/lead on projects.
Experience working in Agile/Kanban environments.

Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, AKS/Kubernetes).
Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform).
Event-driven architectures (Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs).
Security and compliance in cloud environments (identity, secrets management, least privilege).
Observability and monitoring (Application Insights, Azure Monitor).
Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-204, AZ-305) a plus.
Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Angular) is a plus.

We're looking for a
Software Engineer .NET

This role is
Hybrid, Krakow Office

This role is Hybrid in Krakow.

We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer with 1–2 years of professional experience building and shipping applications on the Microsoft .NET stack, relational databases, and AWS. You will join a team that builds cloud-based web applications and services, and you will own features from design discussion through deployment and production support.

You will work primarily in C# and .NET Core building backend services and APIs, write and tune SQL against SQL Server, and deploy and operate workloads on AWS. You will also contribute to our front end, built with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular, and to AI-enabled features built on Generative AI and Large Language Models.

The ideal candidate has already delivered production code, is comfortable owning a well-scoped feature with light oversight, debugs problems methodically, and is curious about applying emerging AI capabilities to real products.

In This Role You Will...

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C# / .NET Core, deployed on AWS.
Write, review, and optimize SQL — queries, stored procedures, views, and schema changes — and diagnose performance issues through execution plans and indexing.
Build and deploy cloud-native components on AWS using services such as Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, S3, RDS, and CloudWatch.
Develop front-end features using React, Angular, or a comparable modern framework, and integrate them with backend APIs.
Own delivery of assigned features end to end: technical design input, implementation, unit and integration tests, code review, and deployment through CI/CD.
Monitor, debug, and improve application performance, security, and reliability, including participation in production support and incident triage.
Investigate functional and technical issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement durable fixes rather than symptom patches.
Participate actively in agile ceremonies, contribute to estimation and technical design reviews, and give constructive feedback in peer code reviews.
Develop and integrate AI-powered features using services such as AWS Bedrock and modern LLM frameworks.
Collaborate across QA, product, operations, IT security, and release management, and communicate status and risks proactively.

You Have Got What It Takes If You Have...

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

1–2 years of professional software development experience building applications in C# and .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+ or .NET Framework).
Demonstrated experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Strong SQL skills against a relational database such as SQL Server: data modeling, joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience deploying or operating workloads on AWS, with working knowledge of at least three commonly used services.
Solid grasp of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, and common design patterns, with the judgment to know when to apply them.
Working experience with a modern front-end framework such as React or Angular, along with strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals.
Experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, and pull request review.
Experience writing automated unit tests with xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
Understanding of secure coding practices and awareness of common vulnerability classes such as those in the OWASP Top 10.
Foundational knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and LLMs, including prompt engineering and practical applications in software development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Entity Framework Core, Dapper, or another ORM, and proficiency with LINQ.
Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, S3, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, or infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform).
Experience building or maintaining microservices and containerized applications with Docker.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or Jenkins.
Familiarity with NoSQL or caching technologies such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Redis.
Experience integrating LLM or AI capabilities into an application using AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain.
Working knowledge of Python, particularly for AI or data-related tasks.
Experience in an Agile or Scrum environment with regular production releases.
Interest in user experience, accessibility, and responsive web design.
AWS certification (Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate) or a relevant Microsoft certification.
Experience with component libraries, state management, or front-end testing tools in the React or Angular ecosystem.

Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

About Lumilens

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact—jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started … and we are building a team in Kraków
.

About The Role

We are building a next-generation Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to power high-volume production of advanced silicon photonics devices (800G, 1.6T, and beyond). This system will serve as the operational backbone of our manufacturing—integrating shopfloor control, data systems, and external platforms (ERP, vendors, contract manufacturers).

This is a foundational, greenfield opportunity to design and build a large-scale enterprise platform from the ground up. You will operate in a highly dynamic, R&D-driven environment—shaping system architecture, defining requirements, and rapidly iterating through prototypes and production systems.

We are hiring across multiple profiles (Senior, Staff, and Technical Lead/Architect) for engineers who thrive in ambiguity and want to build systems that directly impact real-world hardware and manufacturing at scale.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

Design and build distributed backend systems supporting MES and shopfloor control
Define system architecture, APIs, and data models for high-scale, high-reliability environments
Develop microservices and integrations connecting internal systems with ERP, vendors, and manufacturing partners

R&D & Problem Solving

Analyze existing MES and enterprise solutions (commercial and open-source) to inform system design
Translate evolving, loosely defined requirements into robust technical solutions
Lead prototyping, proof-of-concept development, and iterative system refinement

Data & Workflow Integration

Design and implement data pipelines and workflows across multiple systems
Enable real-time data movement, transformation, and event-driven automation
Build integrations that connect manufacturing systems, external partners, and internal tools

Engineering Excellence

Apply best practices in clean architecture, code quality, and system design
Conduct code reviews and enforce strong development standards
Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability through testing and optimization

Qualifications

5+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems
Strong programming experience in languages such as C#, Java, or Go
Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and API design
Strong database design skills (relational models, normalization, performance)
Experience with concurrency, parallelism, and scalable system design
Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and modern development workflows
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to operate in evolving, ambiguous environments
Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

Preferred Qualifications

Technical Lead / Architect (Enterprise Systems)

Experience designing and scaling complex enterprise platforms
Strong system design and architecture leadership
Deep understanding of performance, reliability, and distributed systems trade-offs

Data / Integration Engineer

Experience building data pipelines, workflows, and system integrations
Familiarity with ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow, n8n, or similar)
Strong experience in data transformation, mapping, and automation

Nice to Have

Experience with MES or manufacturing systems
Familiarity with manufacturing concepts:
BOM, work orders, MRP, production planning
Shopfloor operations, quality, traceability, inventory
Experience integrating with industrial equipment or IoT systems
Exposure to frontend technologies (React, Vue)

What we offer

Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
Opportunity to build a greenfield, mission-critical system from the ground up
Direct impact on cutting-edge AI and photonics infrastructure
Collaborative, high-caliber engineering team
Fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant ownership

Experience using AI tools to accelerate the complete software-development lifecycle.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Your future role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-processing solutions.

jobs.description:

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure

Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s
Work collaboratively with other engineers, team members, and across teams
Play a role in developing and fostering Box culture in the Warsaw office and represent Box Poland internally and externally
Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of professional desktop software development experience
Proficient in C++, C#, and/or Swift, with a strong command of software design and architecture principles
Demonstrated experience building and shipping desktop applications on Windows and/or macOS
Comfortable working across the full desktop stack: virtual file systems, OS integrations, networking, sync, and UI
Experienced with unit testing and functional testing practices in an agile team environment
Passionate about building software that is user-friendly, performant, and secure
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
Able to assess, communicate, and complete project milestones with your manager and team members in a time-sensitive manner
Must speak English proficiently

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Windows systems-level programming (Win32 APIs, multi-threading, IPC, COM)
Cross-platform development experience across both macOS and Windows
Prior experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow

Percentage of Time Spent:

15% design and architecture
60% coding, code reviews, and testing
15% bug fixes
5% documentation
5% meetings

Methodology:

Agile management — Scrum
Issue tracking — Jira
Knowledge repository — Box / Confluence / GitHub Enterprise
Code reviews — GitHub Enterprise
Version control — GIT
CI/CD — Jenkins
Communication — Slack / Zoom

Benefits

Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. .

Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.
