jobs.title: Senior AI / ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us:

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing! At BlackLine, we're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business of enterprise applications. Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS Company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash solution, a market leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.

Make Your Mark:

As an AI Engineer at BlackLine, you will be a key player in our mission to bring autonomous finance to every company in the world. You will be at the forefront of developing and deploying innovative applications that leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and foundation models. We are looking for a candidate with a deep understanding of AI Engineering with practical experience deploying GenAI solutions at scale.

You'll Get To:

Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that leverage foundation models to deliver unprecedented insights and efficiency to Finance & Accounting teams.
Develop and implement robust evaluation methodologies for open-ended AI systems, including the use of "AI as a judge" to ensure our solutions meet the highest standards of accuracy and reliability.
Master and apply a variety of model adaptation techniques, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and fine-tuning, to tailor foundation models to specific financial use cases.
Create and manage datasets for training and fine-tuning models, ensuring data quality and relevance.
Build and deploy AI agents that can automate complex financial workflows and interact with various tools and systems.
Optimize the performance of our AI applications, focusing on reducing latency and cost to deliver a seamless user experience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement the best AI-powered solutions to address the challenges faced by the office of the CFO.

What You'll Bring:

Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Proven experience in developing and deploying applications using foundation models (e.g., GPT-4o/o3, Claude Opus 4.x / Sonnet 4.x, Llama 3.x).
A strong understanding of the principles of AI Engineering, as distinct from traditional Machine Learning Engineering.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including techniques for few-shot and zero-shot learning, and defensive prompt design.
Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and its application in building knowledge-intensive applications.
Experience with fine-tuning LLMs and an understanding of when to use fine-tuning versus RAG.
Experience with building and evaluating AI agents that can perform complex, multi-step tasks.
Familiarity with the challenges of evaluating foundation models and experience with designing and implementing evaluation pipelines.
Proficiency in Python or C# and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch).

We're Even More Excited If You Have:

Experience designing or operating AgenticOS patterns (e.g., memory management, tool registries, agent lifecycle orchestration, and inter-agent communication) to build reliable, production-grade autonomous agent systems.
Knowledge of techniques for optimizing inference, including quantization and other methods to improve latency and cost.
Expertise in multi-modal generative models (e.g., text, image, audio) and a proven ability to apply them to create innovative enterprise solutions.
A deep understanding of dataset engineering, including data curation, augmentation, and synthesis. Proven experience in designing and building end-to-end Generative AI systems, from data ingestion and model orchestration to scalable deployment and continuous monitoring.
A strong grasp of LLMOps principles and hands-on experience with tools and platforms for managing the entire lifecycle of Large Language Models in production.
Experience with Model Composition (MCP) techniques, demonstrating an ability to solve complex problems by intelligently combining multiple specialized models or AI agents.
Deep knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical experience in implementing robust guardrails, safety filters, and ethical considerations into generative models to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability.
Familiarity with the financial domain and the challenges of applying AI in a regulated industry.

Thrive at BlackLine Because You Are Joining:

A technology-based company with vision and ambition.
A culture that is kind, open, and diverse.
A workplace that empowers growth and continuous learning.
Professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups.
Equal opportunity employer - inclusivity at the core.
Hybrid work model: at least 3 days per week in office for local candidates

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum Polska
is part of the global Inetum Group and plays a key role in driving the digital transformation of businesses and public institutions. Operating in cities such as Warsaw, Poznan, Katowice, Lublin, Rzeszow, Lodz the company offers a wide range of IT services. Inetum Polska actively supports employee development by fully funding training, certifications, and participation in technology conferences. Additionally, the company is involved in local social initiatives, such as charitable projects and promoting an active lifestyle. It prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all.

Globally, Inetum operates in 19 countries and employs over 28,000 professionals. The company focuses on four key areas:

Consulting (Inetum Consulting): Strategic advisory services that help organizations define and implement innovative solutions.
Infrastructure and Application Management (Inetum Technologies): Designing and managing IT systems tailored to clients’ individual needs.
Software Implementation (Inetum Solutions): Deploying partner solutions from industry leaders like Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.
Custom Software Development (Inetum Software): Creating unique software solutions to meet specific client needs.

With strategic partnerships with major technology giants, including Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, Inetum delivers advanced technological solutions tailored to customer requirements. In 2023, Inetum reported revenues of €2.5 billion, underscoring its strong position in the digital services market.

Inetum distinguishes itself by offering a comprehensive range of benefits that meet the diverse needs of employees, providing flexibility, support and commitment. Here's what makes working at Inetum unique:

Flexible and hybrid work:

Flexible working hours.
Hybrid work model, allowing employees to divide their time between home and modern offices in key Polish cities.

Attractive financial benefits:

A cafeteria system that allows employees to personalize benefits by choosing from a variety of options.
Generous referral bonuses, offering up to PLN6,000 for referring specialists.
Additional revenue sharing opportunities for initiating partnerships with new clients.

Professional development and team support:

Ongoing guidance from a dedicated Team Manager for each employee.
Tailored technical mentoring from an assigned technical leader, depending on individual expertise and project needs.

Community and Well-Being:

Dedicated team-building budget for online and on-site team events.
Opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives and local sports programs.
A supportive and inclusive work culture with an emphasis on diversity and mutual respect.

Job Description

We're looking for a JVM Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in developing, maintaining, and enhancing IoT solutions built on the Cumulocity platform. If you have a strong background in Java, microservices, and a desire to work with cutting-edge IoT technologies, we encourage you to apply!

Main tasks:

Develop and configure IoT applications primarily based on the Cumulocity platform (Administration, Device Management, Cockpit).
Design and implement software components that align with business needs, company standards, and security best practices.
Support and maintain existing IoT solutions, focusing on performance, scalability, and code quality.
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in software architecture design discussions, collaborating closely with architects.
Lead functional or technical scopes within the team, promoting best practices and fostering a culture of excellence.
Produce comprehensive technical documentation and actively share knowledge with the team.
Support the recruitment and onboarding of new developers.

Qualifications

Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot, Java Persistence API) with significant experience in microservices (multi-tenant) and SOA/cloud architectures.
Foundational understanding and practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git, and SonarQube (user-level knowledge for development purposes).
Experience with RESTful APIs and queue/event-based communication (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Azure IoT Hub). Familiarity with web services (REST, OpenAPI specification) and device protocols (HTTP).
Understanding and practical application of OAuth and RBAC.
Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Proficiency in JUnit and Mockito.
Good command of technical and professional English.
Experience working within Agile methodologies (SCRUM).

Nice to have requirements:

Direct experience with Cumulocity (Administration, Device Management, Cockpit).
Familiarity with MQTT, CoAP, TALQ.
Other programming languages: knowledge of Node.js, Python, C++.
Experience with Vitest, Jest.
Knowledge of LAN / LPWAN wireless technologies (e.g., NB-IoT, LoRaWAN).

jobs.title: Azure AI Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Role: Azure AI Technical Support Engineer

Type of hiring: FTC

Type of work: onsite (evening & night shifts)

Location: Krakow, Poland

Start: ASAP

Job description

The ideal candidate should be customer-focused, technically strong, detail-oriented, and capable of managing support issues from initial analysis through final resolution. The candidate should demonstrate ownership, clear communication, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Support Software Engineer with strong expertise in Azure AI, Cognitive Services, Machine Learning, and IoT. This role is focused on supporting production environments, troubleshooting customer and platform issues, ensuring service reliability, and enabling timely resolution of incidents related to AI-driven, cloud-based, and IoT solutions. The ideal candidate should combine strong technical depth with excellent problem-solving, communication, and customer-handling skills.

Responsibilities:

· Provide technical support for Azure AI, Cognitive Services, Machine Learning, and IoT-based solutions in production environments.
· Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents related to AI services, model deployment, APIs, data pipelines, IoT devices, and cloud integrations.
· Analyze logs, telemetry, monitoring s, and service health data to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
· Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and customer teams to drive issue resolution within agreed SLAs.
· Support deployment, configuration, and maintenance of AI/ML and IoT workloads on Azure.
· Assist with performance tuning, cost optimization, reliability improvements, and operational readiness of supported platforms.
· Document troubleshooting steps, known issues, workarounds, root cause analysis, and knowledge base articles.
· Participate in incident management, escalation handling, problem management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Stay current with Azure AI, ML, Cognitive Services, and IoT platform changes to support evolving customer and business needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
· Hands-on experience supporting solutions built on Azure AI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, and related cloud services.
· Strong understanding of incident management, production support, troubleshooting methodologies, and root cause analysis.
· Experience with Azure IoT Hub, IoT Edge, device connectivity, data ingestion, and real-time data processing.
· Good knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, authentication, networking basics, and cloud-native application support.
· Experience reviewing application logs, monitoring dashboards, telemetry, s, and diagnostic data.
· Working knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms.
· Strong awareness of cloud security, access control, data privacy, compliance, and governance practices.
· Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and customer-facing support skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Microsoft Azure certifications in AI, Data, IoT, or cloud administration.
· Experience supporting Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, speech, search, or generative AI workloads.
· Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Service Health, or similar monitoring tools.
· Experience with big data, analytics, event streaming, or messaging services used in AI/IoT platforms.
· Prior experience in L2/L3 technical support, customer escalation management, or managed services delivery.

Key Competencies:

· Strong ownership and accountability in resolving production issues.
· Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced support environment.
· Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
· Structured approach to documentation, escalation, and continuous improvement.

Mandatory Skills:
Azure AI, Cognitive Services, Machine Learning, Cloud Administration

Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer or Full-Stack Engineer with deep backend expertise who can combine software engineering
excellence with a Forward Deployed Engineer
mindset.

This person will work closely with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to rapidly understand problems, design practical solutions, build prototypes, and deliver production-ready applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, translating business needs into technical solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery. A person who enjoys solving complex business problems rather than working with a predefined technology stack.

Required experience and skills:

Experience in consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar.
Experience designing REST APIs, event-driven services, integrations, and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems and quickly become productive.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work directly with clients and operate effectively when requirements are incomplete or rapidly evolving.
Practical experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar.
Valid work permit

AI Engineering capabilities:

Understanding of LLM-based application architecture.
Experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, agents, and RAG patterns.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate the complete software-development lifecycle.
Ability to move quickly from an idea or natural-language requirement to a working prototype without compromising production engineering standards.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless platforms, or microservices.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with observability, infrastructure as code, API management, and integration platforms.

Your future role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-processing solutions.
Build full-stack applications when required, with primary ownership of backend architecture and implementation.
Work directly with clients and business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into working software.
Rapidly prototype, validate, and roll out new solutions.
Take end-to-end ownership, from requirements discovery and solution design to deployment and operational support.
Integrate enterprise platforms, cloud services, databases, APIs, and AI capabilities.
Use AI-assisted development tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and rapid experimentation.
Apply rapid “vibe coding” techniques responsibly while maintaining security, maintainability, testing, and engineering quality.
Build AI-enabled applications using LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and structured data.
Establish reusable development patterns, accelerators, templates, and engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and production troubleshooting.
Collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, frontend developers, and client delivery teams.
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Developer
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven track record integrating Power Platform solutions with enterprise systems via REST APIs, Azure Functions, or Logic Apps.

Experience with .Net framework.

jobs.description:
Company Description

⚡️ Why Altium?

Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before.

Constant innovation has created a transformative technology, unique in its space
More than 30,000 companies and 100,000 electronics engineers worldwide use Altium
We are growing, debt-free, and financially strong, with the resources to become #1 in the EDA industry

Job Description

Role Overview:

Senior Site Reliability Engineer ensures the reliability, availability, and performance of large-scale software systems through a blend of software engineering and systems administration. Key responsibilities involve automating operational tasks, improving observability, and contributing to incident management, while also collaborating with development and technology teams to build more reliable and scalable applications. 

Join Altium as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the reliability and performance of the Altium Cloud Platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Understanding how an Altium Cloud Platform works
Pioneer improvements in observability, including logging, monitoring, and application performance management (APM), ensuring system reliability and proactive issue detection.
Develop and implement reliability frameworks and patterns that standardize and elevate the resilience of our SaaS products across multiple regions and environments.
Cultivate a shared responsibility model where the SRE team collaborates with and educates engineering teams on reliability best practices.
Contribute to incident response and management, ensuring rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and post-incident analysis for continuous improvement.
Participate in system design consulting, platform management, infrastructure upgrades and capacity planning.
Partner closely with engineering and development teams to enhance product stability, observability, and manageability through best practices in reliability engineering.
Partner closely with DevOps/Operations, drive automation initiatives, promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and streamline deployment processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
Champion Service-Oriented Organization (SOO) principles to ensure accountability and clarity in service ownership.

Qualifications

6+ years in SRE, DevOps or related role in a large-scale environment
Software development experience (ideally working with and as a .NET developer)
Strong understanding of SDLC, microservice and HA architecture
Observability - NewRelic, ELK, Grafana, PagerDuty, OTEL or similar
Experience with Kubernetes clusters in production setting, AWS, IOC
Experience with operational tasks
Knowledge of CI-CD tooling Jenkins, Gitlab, GitHub, ArgoCD or similar
Knowledge of IaaC Terraform, Ansible
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals
Experience with relational databases (mysql, postgres) as a plus

Additional Information

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website.

THE WORK

As an Cloud Architect in our Accenture Cloud First team, you will help enterprise clients design and evolve secure, scalable and cost‑efficient cloud landscapes, supporting their digital transformation journeys. Your work will include:

Designing end‑to‑end architectures for cloud, hybrid and on‑premises environments on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Landing Zones, governance and security models.

Defining and implementing compute environments (autoscaling, load balancing, serverless solutions), Azure database services and CI/CD pipelines, with integration to existing on‑premises services.

Designing cloud‑native networking (VNETs, peering, firewalls, container networking) and security & compliance controls (IAM, resource hierarchy, data security, cost management and billing).

Implementing monitoring, logging, profiling and alerting solutions to ensure reliability and observability of client platforms.

Preparing migration approaches and onboarding plans to Azure, including effort estimation, cost and resource calculations, and optimization scenarios.

Partnering with DevOps and engineering teams to apply Infrastructure as Code and automation practices, improve delivery pipelines and support a mature DevOps culture.

Leading or supporting incident, request, change and problem management activities, acting as a trusted technical advisor for client stakeholders.

Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Join Accenture’s Cloud First team if you are motivated to embrace new opportunities, enthusiastic about professional growth and dedicated to evolving your skills. You will:

Work on large‑scale cloud transformation projects for international enterprise clients, expanding your Azure and architecture skill set.

Shape modern cloud, hybrid and on‑premises platforms using automation, containers and DevOps practices, continuously enhancing your technical expertise.

Collaborate with experienced cloud professionals in a diverse team, gaining insights and feedback that support your continuous learning and development.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

5+ years of hands‑on experience in Azure cloud infrastructure engineering.

In‑depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure, supported by advanced/Expert‑level Azure certifications.

Ability to oversee the work of development teams, plan their tasks and translate technical requirements into a structured and actionable backlog.

Experience designing and planning highly available systems, including implementing Disaster Recovery strategies.

Ability to translate client business requirements into technical specifications and ensure their implementation through appropriate configurations within a broader Landing Zone architecture.

Strong understanding of container technologies and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS).

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools.

Solid grasp of virtualization technologies.

Comprehensive knowledge of DevOps culture, practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git/GitLab, Pipelines, Helm charts, ArgoCD).

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer – Smart Manufacturing (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

At Polestar Digital, we build innovative, scalable solutions that power our global platform. You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, delivering systems that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Software Developer, you will be part of a cross‑functional agile team responsible for designing and building high‑performance, scalable solutions that support Polestar’s global digital platform.

You will take ownership of system architecture and technical decision‑making while working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams to deliver reliable and impactful solutions. The role combines hands‑on development, system design, and collaboration, while also contributing to a strong engineering culture through mentoring and knowledge‑sharing.

You will write clean, well‑tested code and contribute to building systems that are robust, scalable, and maintainable. At the same time, you will stay up to date with modern development practices and emerging technologies, including evolving paradigms such as agentic AI.

What you'll do

You will design, build, and evolve scalable digital solutions that power Polestar’s global platform.

Your Responsibilities Include

Designing and implementing high‑performance, globally scalable systems
Taking ownership of system architecture and contributing to technical decision‑making
Writing clean, maintainable code supported by unit, integration, and automated tests
Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams to deliver business value
Mentoring team members and contributing to a culture of knowledge‑sharing
Ensuring solutions follow modern engineering practices across quality, performance, and maintainability

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with cross‑functional agile teams including engineering, product, design, and operations, contributing to a shared understanding of system design, user impact, and business priorities.

Who you are

You are an experienced software developer with a strong engineering foundation and a passion for building scalable, high‑quality systems. You are comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, making decisions, and collaborating across teams to deliver impactful solutions.

You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset, understanding not only how to build solutions but also why they matter. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting others, and continuously improving both code and ways of working.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Strong knowledge of programming and software engineering principles
Experience designing scalable systems using .NET (C#), AWS, and Node.js (TypeScript)
Demonstrated ability to write effective unit tests, integration tests, and other automated tests
Solid understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization
Proficiency with version control systems such as Git and GitHub workflows
4–8 years of professional software development experience
Experience building global, high‑performance, and scalable solutions
Experience working in cross‑functional agile teams
Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to process and analyze complex information
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

It Is Considered An Advantage If You Also Have

Experience working in the financial domain
Interest in emerging technologies, including agentic AI, and how they impact software development

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.

Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you?

If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.

If this sounds like your next challenge, please submit your resume, portfolio, or GitHub profile along with a brief note about what excites you about joining Polestar.

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

jobs.title: .NET Systemutvecklare – AI & Cloud Development
jobs.description:
Vi letar efter dig som är en erfaren utvecklare med vilja att jobba som konsult, inte in i en fyrkantig rollbeskrivning.

Du blir del av vår växande enhet med seniora systemutvecklare och Cloud Engineers. För oss är AI är en självklar del av rollen; flera jobbar hands-on med det som fokus idag och du förväntas utvecklas i samma riktning. Vi har en lättsam stämning där vi alla är med och bygger enheten tillsammans, något vi gärna visar om vi får möjlighet att träffas.

Uppdragen kan variera, exempelvis modernisering & migreringar, tillgängliggörande av data eller AI, implementeringar av automatiseringar och DevOps-lösningar; alltid med moderna tekniker och moln som en självklarhet.

Ingen är perfekt, inte ens vi.

Därför uppskattar vi transparens tidigt. Håller du med om dessa “trade-offs” kan vi vara en match:
Trygghet med fast lön slår provisionsbaserad 💰
Utveckling är ett landskap att utforska , inte en enkelriktad trappa att kliva i hierarkiskt. 🗺️
Inlyssnande och ärliga ledare & sälj-team hellre än tomma löften eller längre tid utan uppdrag 🫶🏻
Att skapa värde är viktigare än att jobba med ens favorit-teknikstack 💎

Våra förväntningar på dig

Vi vet att antal år på ett CV inte säger allt, samtidig påverkar det uppdrags-möjligheter, en grundförutsättning som trygg arbetsgivare. Så ungefär fem år inom systemutveckling ser vi som ett minimikrav. Andra krav vi inte kan bortse från givet nuvarande kund- och projektbehov är:
C# .NET erfarenhet
Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska
Erfarenhet av Azure och/eller AWS

Vi har fler önskemål men vet att flera tekniska kunskaper och erfarenhet kan du få hos oss, vilja att lära dig och utvecklas är den mest värdefulla kompetensen hos oss. Att sälja sig själv i intervjuer är inte allas grej, men likt CV frågan ett faktum som konsult, vi peppar och hjälper dig gärna samtidigt som en grund behövs för att startsträckan inte ska vara för lång.

Nyfiken att höras mer?

Skicka in din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn och svara på några korta frågor som gör att vi snabbare kan få prata med dig! 📨

jobs.description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!

About The Role

As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join a small DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.

Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.

In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.

You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.

AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.

We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
Strong .NET/C# development skills.
Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.

Why join Myntro?

At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.

Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.

Interested? Welcome to apply!

Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.

For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Azra Semic, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – azra.semic@myntro.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Onsite Messaging
jobs.description:
We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.

Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.

We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.

About The Role

This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.

You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.

Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.

Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.

Who you are

We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.

You don’t need experience from our exact technology stack, but we believe you’ve worked with several of the following:

Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices

We also think you:

have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code

High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.

At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Some of our benefits:

30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado

Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.

More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

Ready to make an impact?

Fantastic! 🎉

Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.

Additional information

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

Making it personal with AI

We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

As the Agentic CX Suite for Retail we help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Customer Support Engineer – Hybrid – Gothenburg, Sweden

We seek a Customer Support Engineer to join our team at Microdeb in Gothenburg, Sweden!

About The Role

We're looking for a Support Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. This is not a ticket-shuffling role. You'll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, when a query won't return, when a deployment misbehaves — and you'll have the technical depth to actually fix it, not just escalate it. You'll work across SQL databases, light development tasks, and customer-facing troubleshooting, with modern AI tools as a core part of how you work.

What You'll Do

Own customer issues end-to-end, from first contact through root cause and resolution.

Answer and handle incoming customer support calls as part of the day-to-day role, providing first-line technical assistance, troubleshooting issues, and taking ownership of follow-up through to resolution.

Diagnose and resolve database problems: query performance, indexing, locking, data integrity, backup and recovery.

Write and review SQL — from quick investigative queries to stored procedures and schema changes.

Read, debug, and occasionally patch application code to identify the source of issues.

Reproduce bugs in test environments, file detailed reports for engineering, and follow through. Build internal tools, scripts, and automations that reduce repeat work and speed up diagnosis.

Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, internal LLM workflows) to accelerate investigation, draft responses, generate queries, and analyze logs.

Improve documentation and runbooks so the next person resolves the same issue faster.

What We're Looking For

Solid hands-on experience as a DBA or in a database-heavy support or engineering role. Strong SQL skills — you can write complex queries, read execution plans, and tune performance without reaching for a tutorial. Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar) — enough to read a codebase, debug, and write small fixes or tools. Fluency with AI-assisted workflows: you already use LLMs daily for coding, investigation, and writing, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't. A bias for action: you'd rather dig in and reproduce the issue than wait for more information. Clear written and verbal communication in Swedish and English — you can explain a technical problem to a non-technical customer and to a senior engineer in the same day. Based in or willing to relocate to Gothenburg.

Nice to have

Experience with cloud databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. Swedish language skills are a must for this role.

Why this role

You'll see more of the product, the codebase, and real customer problems than almost any other role. Support engineers here move into platform, backend, or SRE roles when they want to. We invest in AI tooling and expect everyone to use it well — not as a gimmick, but as leverage.

Here is a little window into our company:
Microdeb is a leading provider of integrated payment and order management solutions, helping businesses modernize their payment ecosystems. With years of experience, a dedicated team of experts, and a passion for technology, we continuously innovate to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Microdeb was acquired by Valsoft and now operates under the Aspire Software portfolio. Aspire Software, the operational arm of Valsoft, operates and manages Valsoft’s global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

The successful candidate will be based anywhere in Sweden, working in a hybrid work model from our office in Gothenburg!

Required

About You
:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years in a technical support, DBA, or software engineering role with direct customer or stakeholder contact
Demonstrable SQL expertise: joins, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategy, query plan analysis, and performance tuning on a major RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle)
Hands-on experience administering databases: backups and restores, user and permission management, monitoring, and incident response
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) sufficient to debug application code and write small utilities
Working knowledge of Git and standard development workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
Experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of a daily workflow — writing prompts that produce useful output, knowing when to verify, knowing when not to use them.
Strong written and spoken English. Eligible to work in Sweden

Preferred

Experience with cloud-hosted databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS or Aurora, Google Cloud SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery)
Familiarity with Linux command line, shell scripting, and basic networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, firewalls)
Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with logging and observability stacks (ELK, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry)
Knowledge of REST APIs and how to debug them (Postman, curl, browser dev tools)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
Prior experience in a SaaS or B2B product environment
Swedish language skills

Personal attributes

Curious by default — you want to know why something broke, not just how to make the symptom go away
Comfortable holding two threads at once: the customer who needs an answer now, and the underlying defect that needs a proper fix
Disciplined writer — your tickets, postmortems, and documentation make life easier for the next person. Direct and honest in communication, internally and with customers
Treats AI tools as leverage, not as a crutch — verifies output, understands the code that gets generated, and improves prompts over time

About The Team

You'll join our Support Engineering team in Gothenburg — a technical group that works at the intersection of engineering and customer success
We're the people the rest of the company turns to when something genuinely hard breaks, and we work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to make sure issues get resolved properly, not just closed
How we work: we treat every incident as a chance to learn, document thoroughly so problems don't cost us twice, pair on hard tickets, and push fixes back into the product rather than working around them
We use AI tools heavily as part of our daily workflow and share what works across the team
You can expect real ownership of problems from first report to root cause, direct access to the engineers who built the system, and room to grow into adjacent technical roles over time
We're not a call centre, and we're not a feature factory — we're a team that takes pride in solving real problems well

For further information about Microdeb
, you can visit our website at https://microdeb.se/en/

We thank all applicants for their interest; however only the candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER TILL AKADEMISKA HUS
jobs.description:
Har du byggt och vidareutvecklat Azureplattformar i komplexa hybridmiljöer och vill fortsätta arbeta nära tekniken? Hos Akademiska Hus får du en tekniskt ledande och hands-on roll med stort inflytande över hur vår framtida infrastruktur ska standardiseras, automatiseras och säkras. Här bidrar du både till långsiktiga tekniska vägval och till att lösningarna faktiskt implementeras och fungerar.

DU KOMMER ATT

Akademiska Hus har gjort en omfattande förflyttning från traditionell on-prem-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Samtidigt finns en stor, verksamhetskritisk systemmiljö kvar on-prem. Resultatet är en komplex hybridinfrastruktur där molntjänster och traditionell IT behöver fungera tillsammans – säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Nu går vi in i nästa fas. Det innebär ökad automatisering och repeterbarhet, tydligare standarder och plattformsmönster, förbättrad governance och säkerhetsstyrning samt en mer enhetlig hybrid- och Azureplattform med mindre beroende av manuella arbetssätt.

Som Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll i denna utveckling. Det är en tekniskt ledande engineer-roll där tyngdpunkten ligger på eget genomförande. Du designar, implementerar och felsöker lösningar samtidigt som du samlar teamet kring tekniska frågor, skapar framdrift och stöttar kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och vägledning.

Teamet består av tolv personer i Göteborg och Stockholm, däribland fyra IT-teknikspecialister och tre nätverkstekniker. Tillsammans finns bred kompetens inom bland annat Azure, IAM, serverhallar och virtualisering, VDI, övervakning, brandväggar, SOC, VPN och nätverk. Du arbetar även nära arkitekter och har mandat att påverka tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och plattformens fortsatta utveckling.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure och den hybrida infrastrukturen.
Arbeta hands-on med bland annat Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity och Security.
Utveckla automation och Infrastructure as Code för repeterbara och standardiserade leveranser.
Arbeta med Active Directory, Entra ID och Conditional Access i en komplex hybridmiljö.
Felsöka avancerade tekniska problem och driva lösningar från analys till genomförande.
Bidra till plattformsmönster, tekniska standarder, arkitektur och långsiktiga vägval.
Arbeta med governance, loggning, säkerhetsstyrning och kostnadsoptimering.
Ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetens och utveckling.

DIN PROFIL

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och av förflyttningen från traditionell on-prem till Azure och hybrid cloud. Kanske började du inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och traditionell serverdrift. Med tiden har Azure blivit en allt större del av ditt ansvar och du har arbetat med migreringar, hybridlösningar, identitet, nätverk, säkerhet och automation.

I dag kan du se helheten och bidra till tekniska vägval, men vill fortfarande arbeta nära tekniken. Det viktiga är inte vilka titlar du har haft, utan att du förstår resan eftersom du själv har gjort den.

För rollen behöver du ha:

Flerårig erfarenhet av Azure i komplexa produktionsmiljöer.
Gedigen hands-on erfarenhet av hybrid Azure/on-prem.
God kompetens inom nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.
Erfarenhet av automation och Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform.
Erfarenhet av Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access och PowerShell.
Förmåga att felsöka avancerade problem, genomföra lösningar och ta tekniskt ansvar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure Virtual Desktop, Application Gateway, Application Proxy, Linux, DNS samt PKI och certifikathantering. Relevanta Azure-certifieringar är också meriterande.

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet och utmanar gärna befintliga lösningar när du ser en bättre väg framåt. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, delar med dig av din kunskap och skapar framdrift tillsammans med andra.

Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Göteborg eller Stockholm. Akademiska Hus erbjuder ett flexibelt arbetssätt där utgångspunkten är att du arbetar ungefär hälften av tiden på kontoret. Upplägget planeras tillsammans med närmaste chef utifrån uppdraget. För den som vill finns möjlighet att resa mellan Göteborg och Stockholm för att träffa kollegorna på den andra orten

VILL DU VETA MER?

Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Johanna Värmfors på johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com eller +46 730 821 230, alternativt Artan Bitiqi på artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com eller +46 723 61 28 44.

OM AKADEMISKA HUS

Akademiska Hus är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag och ägs av svenska staten. Tillsammans med universitet och högskolor utvecklar och förvaltar vi kunskapsmiljöer som bidrar till forskning, utbildning och innovation över hela Sverige.Våra fastigheter rymmer allt från undervisningslokaler och kontor till avancerade laboratorier och forskningsmiljöer. Bakom verksamheten finns en omfattande digital och teknisk infrastruktur som är avgörande för att våra miljöer ska fungera och fortsätta utvecklas.

Hos Akademiska Hus får du arbeta i en organisation med ett långsiktigt perspektiv och samtidigt vara en del av en pågående teknisk utveckling. Här finns både komplexiteten i en stor IT-miljö och möjligheten att påverka hur framtidens lösningar ska utformas.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
While generic AI struggles with hallucinations and shallow analysis, Fortune 500 brands need strategic intelligence they can trust with billion-dollar decisions. We're building the specialized AI that delivers it.

We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.

Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows while eliminating hallucinations. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.

The Mission

Build the data backbone that powers billion-dollar decisions at world-leading companies. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to architect and evolve the content systems that handle millions of market research documents and enable strategic decisions at the world's largest brands.

Your mission is to grow our robust, scalable content foundation that enables seamless access to business-critical content through APIs and reliable processing capabilities that other teams build upon.

Our platform processes a massive amount of market research documents and data points, powering intelligent workflows for the core work our users do at global brands.

What Makes This Role Unique

Foundation for AI innovation: Build the content infrastructure that enables our AI brain to process the data that matters.
Enterprise-scale challenges: Handle content ingestion from global industry elading companies with diverse requirements
Ownership: Your decisions impact how thousands of professionals access business-critical insights
Cross-team enablement: Create and evolve the APIs and data models that empower our customer-facing product teams to innovate.

What You’ll Do

Transform How Fortune 500 Companies Access Their Research Intelligence

Connect diverse ecosystems: Build and maintain robust integrations that seamlessly ingest content from diverse enterprise systems
Design for scale: Create content processing systems that handle millions of documents while maintaining low API response times
Enable AI innovation: Build the data models that power our AI brain's ability to synthesize insights across massive content libraries
Set the technical foundation: Establish patterns, standards, and interfaces that enable product teams to rapidly build customer-facing features
Optimize for performance: Ensure reliable, performant content systems across all ingestion channels

What We Need

Back-end expertise: Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and handling large-scale content processing. We care more about your engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework
Cloud-native mindset: Hands-on experience running services in modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar), with containerization and infrastructure as code. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices is important
Integration mastery: Proven track record of building reliable APIs and integration patterns for diverse data sources and formats
System thinking: Ability to design scalable, maintainable data models that empower other teams to build on top of them
Collaboration & curiosity: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with a curious, innovative mindset that thrives in cross-functional teams with product and design
Nice to have: Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, exposure to front-end development (React/TypeScript or similar), deeper familiarity with AWS services

The salary range for this role depends on location and will proactively be shared with you in the first interview.

What’s in it for you?

Join a remote-first, globally distributed team of 100+ professionals from 30+ nationalities, united by our core values: simplicity first, an 'own it, do it' mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together. We bring everyone together for company events throughout the year to strengthen our global connections.

You'll grow alongside seasoned professionals with deep expertise across AI, market research, and enterprise systems. We offer exceptional career development opportunities in our fast-evolving market, competitive compensation, and a collaborative culture where everyone actively supports each other's success.

Most importantly, you'll have the satisfaction of simplifying the professional lives of thousands of Brand Managers and Consumer Insights professionals worldwide, making their strategic decisions more data-driven and impactful.

Ready to build the AI that powers Fortune 500 strategy? Join us.

Stravito is the insights platform for the world's leading enterprises, right in the middle of an exciting transformation from a SaaS company into a world-class AI company. We bring all of a company's customer and market knowledge into one place, making it findable, usable, and ready to act on, so insights teams can make sharper, fact-based decisions. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden in 2017, Stravito today works with some of the world's most recognised brands and is home to 100 employees across 10 countries in Europe and North America.

jobs.title: System Architect Core & Credits
jobs.description:
We are strengthening our architecture capabilities and are looking for a System Architect for Core & Credits. In this role, you will help shape the technical direction of our credit solutions while working closely with Team Credit and fellow architects across the organization. You will combine hands-on development with architectural responsibility, contributing both to day-to-day delivery and to the long-term evolution of our products.

Personal Skills

We are looking for a proactive and self-driven person with strong analytical skills, integrity, and the ability to see the bigger picture. You communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and combine a business-oriented mindset with solid technical understanding.

Main Responsibilities

As System Architect, you will take part in both hands-on development and architectural work. You will support the team by clarifying requirements, designing technical solutions, guiding implementation, and helping ensure that our systems remain secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the product roadmap.

Define And Analyze System Requirements

– Define and analyze functional and non-functional system requirements in close collaboration with system users, product owners, and other stakeholders.

– Translate requirements into clear guidance for developers and application managers through models, prototypes, guidelines, and instructions.

Develop Technical Roadmap

– Develop, maintain, and communicate the technical roadmap for your area of responsibility.

– Actively reduce existing technical debt and help prevent new technical debt from being introduced.

– Drive system changes in line with the roadmap and help ensure that development progresses in a coordinated and sustainable way.

Evaluate Cost and Time

– Assess cost, time, and value when evaluating manual routines, hardware, third-party products, existing software, or new development.

Architectural Design and System Decomposition

– Design and evolve the fundamental system structure that supports ongoing product development.

– Support developers and application managers in resolving issues in a way that is consistent with the architectural direction.

– Make technical decisions within your area of responsibility, in alignment with the roadmap and relevant stakeholders.

– Align with your immediate manager before decisions that may involve additional costs. Decisions of a significant nature are made by the company's Chief Architect or Management team.

– Guide teams in evaluating both human-created and AI-assisted design or code suggestions, ensuring that solutions are sound, secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the overall architecture.

Customer and Sales Engagement

– Support new sales and upselling activities for both new and existing customers.

– Help answer solution-related questions and contribute technical insight in customer dialogue.

Desired Education And Experience

– University-level education in software development, or equivalent practical experience.

– Extensive experience and strong expertise in software design and development.

– Must have experience: working in an IBM i environment and with RPGLE as a programming language.

– Merited experience: Working with a Java technology stack and frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring for building production-ready environments and REST APIs.

– Merited experience: AWS or other cloud public clouds.

Business domain knowledge within credits is merited.
Proficiency in agile software development.
Proficiency in data security.
Fluency in English is required. Swedish is desirable, and Finnish is considered a bonus.
You have a pragmatic AI-first mindset and are positive about using AI as support for productivity and analysis, while applying professional judgment and taking ownership of the final result.

Could this be your next step? If you are motivated by combining hands-on development with architectural responsibility, we would be happy to hear from you.

The role can be based in either Mariehamn, Helsinki, Turku, Stockholm

For further information, please contact Technical Development Manager Sebastian Skogman by email at sebastian.skogman@crosskey.fi or HR Manager Monika Sigmark by email at monika.sigmark@crosskey.fi We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 30 September 2026.
