jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer, Solna
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the infrastructure of scalable, secure, and future-proof data platforms that power analytics, AI, and business-critical insights? Do you thrive in environments where automation, cloud technologies, and platform reliability are at the core of everything you do? We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer who wants to play a pivotal role in shaping and operating a modern Azure and Databricks-based data platform that enables data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI innovation at scale.

About The Role

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports analytics, reporting, AI, and data product development. You will help establish platform standards, develop automation capabilities, and ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, and resilient. Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and Security teams, you will drive the evolution of a modern cloud-based platform that enables seamless data ingestion, processing, and consumption across the organization.

As a key member of the team, you will manage and optimize Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, networking, and supporting platform services. You will implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and create observability frameworks that provide transparency into platform health, performance, and cost efficiency. You will also play an important role in troubleshooting complex issues, improving operational excellence, supporting disaster recovery planning, and enabling AI and machine learning capabilities through robust platform engineering practices.

Beyond the technical responsibilities, you will act as a trusted subject matter expert, helping engineering teams adopt cloud platform best practices while continuously driving improvements in reliability, security, governance, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for someone who combines a strong engineering foundation with hands-on experience building and operating the infrastructure of enterprise-scale cloud platforms.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles.
Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure in Azure.
Experience supporting modern data platforms, analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads.

Key Technical Skills

We're looking for someone with strong expertise across several of the following areas:

Azure cloud and data platforms, including Azure Databricks Administration, Azure Data Lake, data integration services, and analytics workloads.
Infrastructure as Code and platform automation, including Terraform, Git, CI/CD, automated provisioning, and configuration management.
Containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and Docker.
Cloud networking and identity management, including Azure Networking, Entra ID/IAM, DNS, connectivity, private networking, routing, and firewalls.
Security, compliance, and governance, including implementation of security controls and governance frameworks within regulated environments.
Observability and platform operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, high availability, platform reliability, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Scripting and automation, using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

Nice to have

Experience with any of the following would be considered an advantage:

Microsoft Purview and Apache Airflow.
MLOps and Azure AI Services.
Multi-cloud environments.
Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or Databricks Platform Administrator certifications.
Experience from the logistics industry.

Language Requirements

Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Swedish, Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian is considered an advantage

Who you are

You are a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and building reliable platforms that create value at scale. With a strong analytical mindset and a passion for troubleshooting, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence are key. You take a structured approach to problem-solving, have a natural sense of ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality solutions. At the same time, you're a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Business teams, enabling effective stakeholder engagement and driving results through cross-functional collaboration.

We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please email recruiting manager Linda Njeru at linda.njeru@postnord.com.

As a Backend Developer, you will be part of the team that designs, develops, and maintains the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to deliver technical solutions aligned with business goals.

God kompetens inom nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.

Förmåga att felsöka avancerade problem, genomföra lösningar och ta tekniskt ansvar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

jobs.title: Software and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Join EQT Tech’s Architectural function, where you’ll play a critical role in future-proofing and scaling one of our cross-functional value streams—Fintech.

This is a unique opportunity to design and drive the technology supporting our financial operations — ensuring seamless integrations, efficiency, and innovation. If you're a strategic thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing scalable systems, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Tech Team – Fintech Value Stream

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate with Tech Leads, Engineers, and external partners to design and implement solutions that drive efficiency and scalability across EQT’s investment technology.

Beyond your work in the Fintech Value Stream, you'll also collaborate closely with peers in the Architecture function to shape EQT Tech's long-term architectural direction, ensuring consistency, reusability, and strategic alignment across value streams.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with tech leads and engineers to support the Fintech Value Stream in new projects & initiatives, engaging in technical discussions with both third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure a structured approach to solution development
Assess the current architecture, team capabilities, and resource allocation to determine the best approach for future implementations
Develop new architectural solutions and enhance existing ones to ensure they are harmonized, scalable, and efficient for all of EQT
Establish technical standards, best practices, and improved ways of working across EQT’s Tech teams
Collaborate with other Value Streams (Investment & Client) and Platform Teams to define interfaces, ownership, and capabilities within the Fintech domain
Design system integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between internal systems, new external systems, and vendors
Work closely with the Head of Architecture and the Head of Fintech, supporting key strategic initiatives

Who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced Software and Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and a strategic mindset. You should have a passion for problem-solving, system design, and technical leadership. You likely have 8–12 years of experience across software engineering and architecture, including time spent designing systems in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience designing and maintaining complex, high-availability systems that handle sensitive data
Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data architectures
Proven ability to drive implementation from initial requirements to high-level solution design and progress tracking
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the confidence to take a firm stance in technical discussions
Excellent communication skills, able to engage effectively with key stakeholders and external partners
Proactive mindset, with a desire to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
Curiosity about applying AI and advanced analytics to drive business value and innovation

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with modern data stacks and frameworks (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, SQL, Fivetran)
Familiarity with financial systems such as Netsuite, Kyriba, Hazeltree, MRI, or Aaro, and BI tools like PowerBI or Hex

What We Offer

A fast-paced and dynamic work environment at a leading global investment firm
The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and develop the future of EQT’s financial tools
A collaborative and inclusive company culture where innovation is encouraged
Regular hackathons, workshops, and learning opportunities to develop new skills
Competitive compensation and benefits package
A vibrant office environment in central Stockholm

Inclusion at
EQT

Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.

About EQT

EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.

With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.

More info: www.eqtgroup.com

Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram

About the position

The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and evolves complex cloud infrastructure and automation solutions with a high degree of autonomy. This role owns systems and solutions that have significant impact on service reliability, security posture, and operational scalability. Senior Cloud Engineers act as technical leaders within the team, contributing to standards, mentoring peers, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.
The position can based in our Stockholm, we follow a hybrid work model with excellent flexible working practices. Applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Sweden.

Responsibilities  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Owns and evolves complex Infrastructure as Code solutions across the cloud environment
Makes independent design decisions within established architectural standards
Delivers improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and team efficiency
Provides technical guidance and review for less senior engineers

Configuration

Designs and maintains complex configuration management solutions
Defines configuration patterns and best practices used across the environment
Reviews and guides configuration work performed by other engineers

Data Center Operations

Maintains an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all physical hardware within the data center, such as HSMs, USBs, Smartcards, SSDs and Shock-Proof cases. Informs supervisor when certain materials are running low.
Maintains detailed records of all data center operation activities, including changes to tamper evident bag numbers, incidents, and access to client materials. Follows proper procedures on strict guidelines for Root Signings, Disaster Recovery, CRLs and CSR signings. Ensures proper asset disposal procedures are followed.
Is able to follow documented procedures on how to properly handle sophisticated hardware security modules and KVM devices. Can perform configurations of the hardware security module and KVM with supervision from more senior peers.

Drives automation initiatives that improve operational consistency and efficiency
Supports process improvement through tooling and automation

Networking

Applies deep knowledge of networking protocols and standards to support hosted services
Participates in compliance audits and provides technical input

Monitoring & Alerting

Defines and improves monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies
Ensures monitoring logic supports service reliability and rapid incident detection
Mentors peers on monitoring best practices

Patch Management

Leads patch management strategies and execution
Resolves escalated patching issues and drives process improvements
Contributes to the evolution of patching standards and practices

PKI Knowledge

Produces technical documentation for PKI designs and processes
Participates in cross-functional certificate reviews

Product Knowledge

Serves as a subject matter expert on Keyfactor’s hosted products

Participates in strategy and design discussions for new product offerings
Supports testing of new product versions and provides feedback to product teams
Interfaces with customers on hosted architecture and security posture when required

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills  

High School Diploma or equivalent experience  
5+ years of related work experience and strong knowledge within their functional area
Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including native services and tooling
Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools
Advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting (high complexity)
Extensive experience with Windows systems administration, including Windows Roles & Features
and Active Directory
Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor
Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within and across cross-functional teams
Self-motivated, able to manage complex work and projects to completion with minimal oversight
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Up to 15% travel time required

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.  
Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.

Our Core Values 

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  
Trust
is paramount.

never stops, it only accelerates.

We deliver with
agility
.

United by
respect
.

Teams
make “it” happen.

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems and integration patterns.

jobs.title: AI Software Developer i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar.

Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här.

När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som AI Software Developer

Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här.

Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt:

RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur
Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande.
Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. .

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify).
💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukostar

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en spännande möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant av AI-utveckling!
Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom AI-utveckling. Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på LinkedIn eller mailadressen jacob.beck@solita.se.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Placeringsort för denna roll är i Stockholm, Sverige

Overview

Team Purpose:
Our team plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices and silicon, from Arm-based laptops to gaming consoles. We maintain the health of the Windows application ecosystem, ensuring that every Windows OS release remains compatible with the vast breadth of applications that customers, enterprises, and partners rely on every day. As part of Windows Silicon & Systems Integration, we are responsible for the quality and compatibility of both in-market devices and new hardware, spanning multiple form factors, silicon vendors, and customer segments. In recent years the OS underwent significant rejuvenation, and we continue to evolve the platform to support new devices and AI features. We are expanding our team to ensure we succeed - there has never been a better time to come and work on Windows.

Job Purpose:
As a Senior Software Engineer

You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to turn customer signals into product improvements, scalable troubleshooting guidance, proactive monitoring, and readiness for new features. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Description

Are you excited by the prospect of solving some of the hardest and most valued technical challenges of cloud computing? Do you want to apply your deep analytical and engineering skills to the space of highly-available replicated databases? Come join us in Amazon RDS and help us innovate!

The AWS Relational Database Service (RDS) is one of the largest cloud database businesses, providing super-simple provisioning and management for databases in the cloud. Customers can set up a new database with just a few clicks, and complex administrative tasks like scaling, fail-over, and monitoring are handled in an automated fashion by our control systems. Providing such simplified management for customers comes with the challenge of building sophisticated and reliable control systems. The systems we build manage huge numbers of databases and vast amounts of storage across multiple datacenters world-wide, and our service is growing rapidly, requiring constant innovations in our systems in order to handle the next order of magnitude in service scale.

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer to join us and take ownership of significant features and components end-to-end. You’ll work on distributed systems that operate at scale across every AWS region from Active Directory and Kerberos authentication improvements, to third-party integrations, to tooling that helps customers manage their workload in our managed service. You will own the design and delivery of complex components, work independently through ambiguity, and help raise the technical bar for the team through design and code reviews and mentorship of junior engineers.

AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities

Own and Lead design discussions, making sound trade-offs across performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
Work on third party integrations and security capabilities.
Troubleshoot production issues and drive both immediate fixes and long-term corrective actions.
Mentor junior engineers, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to team-wide engineering standards.
Collaborate with product managers, partner teams, and stakeholders to translate customer needs into technical deliverables.

A day in the life

As You Design And Code Solutions To Help Our Team Drive Efficiencies In Software Architecture, You’ll Create Metrics, Implement Automation And Other Improvements, And Resolve The Root Cause Of Software Defects. You’ll Also

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About The Team

We are the Dublin based team for RDS SQL Server, a close-knit group of engineers who care deeply about building secure, reliable database management technology that customers trust with their most critical workloads. Our work spans vendor integrations, security and authentication, multi-region expansion, and migration tooling, so no two problems look quite the same.

We value ownership, curiosity, and a bias for action. Whether it’s deepening your database internals expertise, working across AWS service teams, or driving a feature from design to global rollout, you’ll find room to grow here and a team that has your back.

For more information on RDS SQL Server, please visit: http://aws.amazon.com/rds/sqlserver

We are a collaborative team that values ownership, customer obsession, and technical excellence. We partner broadly across RDS and take pride in making complex things simple. We believe in giving engineers real autonomy, investing in their growth, and building software we are proud to put in front of customers.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the architectural direction for the platform, write production code, review pull requests, and act as the senior technical authority the engineering team relies on for difficult decisions. You will also work closely with both the Product team to set the API standards along with engineering teams across the API portfolio to develop and maintain the platform's API design standards, security models, and integration patterns. If you’re an engineer who enjoys both deep technical work and influencing standards across a global organization, this role offers significant scope and impact.

Responsibilities

Define the architecture of the developer platform, including the API gateway, authentication, metering, billing integration, and settlement, ensuring it is sound, extensible, and cloud-native from the outset.
Own the end-to-end platform architecture from the developer experience through to the registry, including all aspects of commercialization, adoption, support, monitoring, and analytics.
Work with the Product team to set API standards that will allow for monitoring, authentication, metering, and registration.
Write production code and review pull requests; remain the senior hands-on technical contributor on the team and unblock engineers on the critical path.
Serve as the primary technical interface between the Developer Platform, Product & Technology and product engineering teams, building credibility as the go-to person for platform questions.
Jointly develop and publish API Design Standards v1, working collaboratively with product teams so that standards reflect the technical reality of what those teams are building and are adopted in practice.
Own platform standards and governance: define the telemetry schema, maintain hub listing requirements, and establish the security and integration patterns applied across all API families.
Establish IMS OAuth as the standard authentication model across all platform surfaces.
Define and document migration paths for existing APIs to meet platform standards.
Ensure AI and MCP surfaces are first-class citizens in the platform architecture and taxonomy, with documented agent integration patterns alongside traditional REST APIs.
Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical hiring, team structure, and delivery sequencing.
Partner with the CIO organization on enterprise application and ERP integration and unified architecture.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience and significant time spent architecting large-scale systems.
Proven ability to own the comprehensive developer platform architecture spanning from the front-end developer experience down to the API registry encompassing commercialization, adoption, support and analytics.
Demonstrated experience partnering closely with Product teams to define and establish global API standards that enable monitoring, authentication, metering and registration.
Experience managing enterprise IT architectures coupled with a proven track record of building and shipping custom, customer-facing API-driven software.
Strong technical expertise in OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token handling, and underlying platform security models.
Hands-on experience engineering distributed systems, event streaming, API gateways, routing, usage-based billing pipelines, and ERP/settlement integrations.
Unique blend of hands-on coding ability and the communication skills to work credibly and collaboratively with multiple distinct product engineering teams.
Familiarity with AI/agent integration patterns and MCP is a strong plus.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders and engineers across organizational boundaries.

An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
An attractive salary and benefits package.

A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

Demonstrates strong understanding of software engineering processes such as agile methodologies, code-reviews, writing functional specifications

to join Procore’s Product & Technology Team. Procore builds software that improves the lives of everyone in construction, and our Product & Technology organization drives our innovative, global platform at scale.

We are a customer-focused team spanning engineering, product, design, data, security, and business systems. As a Staff Engineer, you will play a critical role in shaping the architecture and backend systems that power Procore’s Building Information Modelling (BIM) and construction management solutions worldwide.

This position reports to a Senior Director of Engineering and is based in our Norway location.

What You’ll Do

Lead the design and development of high-performance backend systems written in Rust/C/C++, powering Procore’s BIM and construction technology platform.
Architect and build scalable, distributed services aligned with Procore’s service-oriented and microservices architecture.
Own complex technical initiatives from concept to production, ensuring reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Platform teams to deliver robust APIs and backend services.
Establish and promote engineering best practices in system design, code quality, testing, and performance optimization.
Drive architectural decisions that support enterprise-scale customers across international markets.
Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, providing technical leadership, code reviews, and design guidance.
Anticipate scalability, reliability, and performance challenges in large distributed systems and proactively design solutions.
Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and operational excellence across backend services.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional experience building production-grade backend systems.
Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17/20 or later), including memory management, concurrency, and performance optimization.
Experience designing and building distributed systems and microservices at scale.
Deep understanding of multithreading, networking, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with service-oriented architecture and API design (REST/gRPC).
Familiarity with containerized environments and cloud-native infrastructure.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system-level design.
Experience working with high-throughput, low-latency systems.
Experience operating software at scale (thousands of hosts, millions of users).
Track record of identifying architectural risks early and driving long-term technical strategy.
Experience designing CI/CD pipelines and improving developer productivity.
Strong documentation skills and ability to bring clarity to complex technical solutions.

Experience with 3D data processing, geometry engines, or BIM systems.

Vil du bli del av et tverrfaglig og inkluderende fagmiljø som samarbeider tett på tvers av avdelinger i SoftwareOne ?  
Vil du være med å videreutvikle SoftwareOne sitt konsulentmiljø i Arendal/Kristiansand, med spennende sky-, digitaliserings- og transformasjonsprosjekter for norske kunder?

Sted: Arendal/ Kristiansand , Norge

| Språkkrav: Norsk
og engelsk
på et profesjonelt /flytende nivå, muntlig og skriftlig

Kartlegge kundebehov og gi rådgivning om hvordan Power Platform og Microsoft cloud -teknologi kan skape forretningsverdi for våre kunder  
Designe og utvikle løsninger med Power Apps, Power Automate , Power BI, Dataverse og Copilot Studio  
Automatisere og modernisere arbeidsprosesser på tvers av Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams og Azure , med fokus på sikkerhet, governance og skalerbarhet

Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse og Copilot Studio

Azure eller andre skyplattformer

Er driftig, målrettet og kundeorientert, og trives med å omsette kundens behov til gode tekniske løsninger

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.

jobs.title: AI Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
We at Solita have helped leading Nordic companies turn early AI experiments into scalable, secure, and value-driven AI programs. With hundreds of projects and 2,000+ experts in the areas of software development, data, AI, cloud and design, we bridge the gap between ideas and impact. Join us to build tomorrow’s technical solutions!

Currently, we’re on a mission to build intelligent systems for our customers that unlock and harness the value of data and AI. Also, AI is transforming how we build software: automating routine work, amplifying creativity, and letting developers focus on solving real problems.

We are now looking for AI Full-Stack Developers
to join our growing community of experts and help shape the future of intelligent software. In this role, you can work in the Helsinki, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere, or Turku regions with hybrid working options.

At Solita, you’ll find a community that values both technical excellence and human connection. We believe in autonomy, continuous learning, and building together things that matter. You’ll have the chance to work on impactful projects with meaningful use of AI, collaborate with top experts across data, cloud, and design.

Read more of our thoughts on AI from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Developer, you get to develop various agent-based and data-driven software solutions that have a real impact on our customers in various industries, both in private and public sectors. In addition to utilizing modern software development toolkits in your daily work, you will be working hands-on with various AI tools and frameworks, such as AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP or AI Foundry to build secure, scalable and maintanable AI-powered software solutions that help our customers make better decisions, automate intelligently, and create real business value. You’ll work closely with a team of other software developers, AI/Data Scientists and Engineers, participating in the entire software development cycle.

We are a technology-agnostic company, always choosing the modern frameworks and platforms that best support the customer’s needs. The diversity of our projects offers excellent opportunities for learning, skill development, and rotation. You can find more information about our work on our Dev blog and in the results of our Developer Survey.

Here’s how our developer Miska describes his experience working on AI-based projects:
“I’ve had the opportunity to work on two AI-based projects at Solita and have been involved in both design and implementation. In both projects, it became clear that truly leveraging AI requires a pragmatic approach, continuous measurement, and above all, a deep understanding of the problem being solved. During the projects, I’ve worked with tools such as Cursor, LangGraph, Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT. Developing AI solutions has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career: it’s rare to work on something that simultaneously feels like exploring something entirely new and building the future.”

Read more of our developers’ thoughts on ‘How AI is reshaping software projects’ from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

What we are looking for

We hope you share our passion for writing high-quality code and collaborating in cross-functional teams. You don’t need to have worked under the title “AI Developer” before: what matters most is your curiosity towards AI, strong technical skills, and the ability to bridge software development and AI in your daily work.

We Expect You To Have

A strong background in software development: at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development using Java, TypeScript, C# or Python.
Experience using agentic coding assistants as part of your daily work (like Github Copilot or Claude Code)
An understanding of AI agent architectures and modern AI frameworks (e.g. AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP, or AI Foundry) is considered an advantage.
Experience with cloud-based AI services (AWS or Azure) and bringing AI solutions into production using DevOps and IaC practices is considered an advantage.
Fluent English language skills. fluent Finnish skills are considered as an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative mindset.

Why Solita is a great place to work

An expert community: Join our Dev community of over 400 top-tier software professionals in Finland. You’ll also get to collaborate with colleagues across our organization with other +2,000 Solitans.
Rotations and growth: At Solita, your career path doesn’t have to be linear. Many of our people have explored different roles and projects within the company, supported by our internal rotation opportunities, mentoring, and the Solita Growth Academy.
Freedom and flexibility: We know there is more to life than work. That is why we value flexibility and support a healthy work–life balance through trust, autonomy, and a culture that puts people first.
People first: Your wellbeing matters to us as much as your skills. We offer flexible ways of working, comprehensive employee benefits, and dedicated People Leads who provide support in all kinds of everyday situations.
Benefits for every need: Pick the devices that suit you best, enjoy extensive occupational healthcare, relax with regular massages, work with our in-house coaches, or recharge through our hobby clubs and community activities.
Fair and transparent pay: We believe great teamwork happens when there’s no pressure from billing-based salary models: that is why we offer a fixed monthly salary and encourage collaboration and shared success.

Got interested?

Let’s find out together if this could be the next step in your career at Solita! Please send us your CV, or link to your LinkedIn profile.

Our recruitment consists of two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.

Any thoughts or questions, please reach out to our recruiter Neea Turunen / neea.turunen@solita.fi

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. In addition, some of our customers may carry out a separate security clearance vetting made by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service, for example in case you start working for a customer operating in critical infrastructure sector.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment
In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

If you’re interested in learning more, please feel free to reach out to me for additional information:
Virpi Kivinen

virpi.kivinen(at)nortal.com

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer to support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure within our Microsoft Azure environment. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to automate deployments, manage containerized workloads, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient cloud operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious individual eager to build a career in cloud engineering.

How You'll Create Impact

Provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud resources across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep and ARM templates, following established standards and approval processes.
Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, cost optimization, and application health using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Assist in analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Participate in day-to-day cloud operations including incident response, change management, access reviews, and cloud resource tagging.
Deploy, operate, and support containerized applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with an emphasis on secure-by-default and safety-focused configurations.
Support AKS safety and security features including:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege access
Network policies and private cluster configurations
Pod and container security best practices
Cluster and workload observability using logs, metrics, and alerts
Patch management and Kubernetes version upgrades under guidance

Perform scaling, health monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of Kubernetes workloads using kubectl, Helm, and Azure CLI.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and deployment automation in collaboration with developers using GitHub Actions, with attention to deployment safety, validation, and rollback strategies.
Create and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, observability standards, security controls, and operational procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

Your Background

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and core services such as Virtual Machines, App Services, Storage, Networking, and identity services.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services, namespaces) and container orchestration concepts.
Experience using Docker and container deployment tools such as Helm.
Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or programming languages such as Python or C#.
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals including RBAC, identity management, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles.
Ability to follow defined processes and controls while progressively taking ownership of assigned systems and tasks.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.

Travel Expectations

Occasional overnight travel as necessary.

This is a full-time position and it may reasonably require additional hours during the week and weekend; specific requirements will be determined with Manager.

We're starting with insurance, because we think it's one of the clearest places to prove that financial services can be done differently, and better. Insurance and cashback are the beginning of a long, healthy customer relationship, one we build our wider portfolio of products around.
We're a seed-stage company, which means your voice shapes where we go next. You'll have real influence over decisions and over our customers' lives. We're building the founding team now. Join us.

What you'll do Build Vahva's consumer platform from the ground up, working side by side with the founder. You are the founding engineer in a growth-stage company bringing a new kind of insurance concept to market, first in Finland under the Vahva brand.
Ship product end-to-end: design, implement, deploy, and operate the services behind our cashback and insurance products (vahva.fi), which reward customers with real money for claim-free months, and the car-insurance products the platform grows into.

AI engineering, applied from the ground up

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an AI Architect to join our AI, Analytics & Agents business area in Finland.

At Solita AI, Analytics & Agents community, we support our customers throughout their entire AI journey, from early ideation to scaling AI adoption across the whole organization. We believe that impactful AI solutions are created through multidisciplinary collaboration, combining business and process expertise, cutting-edge technology & AI expertise, and human-centered design. Generative AI and the application of large language models are an increasingly important part of our solutions.

We take a holistic approach to our customers’ challenges and help them build sustainable, production-ready AI solutions that deliver value in real use cases.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Architect, you take lead responsibility for designing, developing, and driving production‑grade AI solutions for our customers. You combine hands‑on architectural work with project‑level technical leadership, acting as both the solution architect and a senior technical contributor.

In this role, you own the overall AI solution architecture: mapping the current state of data, analytics and AI capabilities, defining future target architectures, identifying opportunities, and creating concrete, actionable roadmaps. You will be involved in all phases of the project, from ideation, and solution design to production deployment, and continuous development.

Your work places a strong emphasis on LLM-based and generative AI solutions that are embedded into real business processes. You ensure that AI solutions are designed as part of a broader IT and enterprise architecture with clear attention to security, scalability, reliability and responsible AI.

You lead AI architecture work in large projects and across teams, collaborating closely with Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Cloud Architects, data specialists and business stakeholders. While you are expected to be hands-on when needed, your key responsibility is to own the overall AI solution architecture, make critical technical decisions, and ensure high‑quality outcomes.

In addition, you contribute to Solita’s technical leadership in applied AI by shaping best practices, supporting pre‑sales and solution planning, mentoring colleagues, and influencing how production‑grade AI is delivered across customer projects.

We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range from 5800 € to 7200 €.

In practice your work includes:

Taking technical lead responsibility in AI projects, acting as a hands‑on AI Architect and guiding the overall solution from concept and implementation to production.
Working closely with customers in a consultative role, translating business needs and constraints into concrete technical designs and implementation plans.
Designing and developing LLM‑based and generative AI solutions, such as knowledge and information retrieval systems, agent‑based workflows, systems that increase the level of automation in (customer) service processes and document processing solutions.
Defining end‑to‑end AI system designs, including data flows, model orchestration, system integrations, evaluation, guardrails, and human‑AI interaction.
Designing cloud‑based AI and LLM platforms, primarily on Azure, leveraging services such as Azure AI / ML, Databricks, and cloud‑native infrastructure.
Leading architectural decisions related to scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and responsible AI, in alignment with broader IT and enterprise architecture.
Participating in pre‑sales and early project phases, supporting solution scoping, technical proposals, and architecture planning in collaboration with sales.

What helps you succeed in this role

Proven experience in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions in production environments, especially with generative AI and LLM technologies.
Solid experience in mapping out architecture-level AI solutions for both business decision-makers and the implementing experts in an understandable way.
You understand deeply the logic and practicalities related to AI solutions, and non-deterministic solutions in general, and their successful development.
Hands-on experience as an AI Architect, ML Architect, Lead AI/ML Engineer or similar role, with clear responsibility for architectural decisions.
Experience with generative AI and agent architectures, including LLM technologies (e.g. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG methods, and multi-agent solutions.
Experience in production deployment and solution operations using technologies such as Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluation and guardrail tools.
Architectural and hands-on experience with cloud-based AI platforms (Azure, AWS), including building cloud infrastructure using IaC tools.
Programming skills, especially with Python but other languages such as Java or C# are also beneficial.
Ability to act as a trusted consultant, guiding and challenging our customers and collaborating effectively with teams.
Passion for solving customer needs and exploring the latest AI technologies and methods (e.g. multi-agent architectures and collaboration mechanisms, self-optimizing AI agents, agent skills, advanced knowledge and memory management solutions, etc.)
Fluent working proficiency in English.
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical experts and business stakeholders and to lead discussions around architecture
Solita's values (caring, casualness, courage, and passion) align with what you value in your work community and colleagues.

What do we offer?

Challenging, meaningful, and impactful projects with a wide variety of clients, from global companies to public organizations.
A diverse community of exceptional professionals who love to learn, challenge and support each other. You won’t be left alone.
A relaxed, caring and trust-based culture where you can be yourself.
A workplace with both freedom and responsibility. That’s what our employees see as one of the biggest benefits at Solita.
Freedom to work either remotely in Finland, in our customers’ premises, or in our offices across Finland – which option suits best at a given time.
Mentoring, coaching, and cross-unit learning opportunities to grow your expertise through Solita's multidisciplinary collaboration, long-term client work, or domain specialization (e.g., Retail, Industrial, Health).

Read more about our projects and insights from our professionals:

Solita employs several dozen professionals in data science & AI/ML engineering who work on domestic and international projects in Finland and the Nordic countries. Our professionals work as in-depth experts in their respective fields in various customer projects, e.g. in projects like this or for example at KONE.

“ At KONE we are for example supporting them to develop an intelligent maintenance service called KONE 24/7 Connected Services. An exciting project around machine learning and sensor data from more than 150,000 elevators. ” – Mikael Ruohonen, AI, Analytics & Agents, Business Lead

On a journey towards AI-driven HR service solutions across 50 countries – Solita

Significant opportunities for Kela through AI – Solita

Driving AI solutions in sustainable stainless steel production – new digital innovation hub – Solita

Data and AI strategy helps YIT boost productivity – Solita

Breaking new ground in software development with AI-powered collaboration – Solita

Got interested?

Let’s find out together if this could be the next step in your career at Solita! Please send us your CV or a link to your LinkedIn profile through our website. We would be happy to discuss what kind of role and project setup would best match your skills and goals. Please note that this role requires you to be located in Finland. Solita does not support relocation.

Our recruitment consists of phone screening and two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.

If you would like more information about the role, please contact our recruiter Neea Turunen (neea.turunen@solita.fi). Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. In addition, some of our customers may carry out a separate security clearance vetting made by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service, for example in case you start working for a customer operating in critical infrastructure sector.

AI / ML Engineerin roolissa suunnittelet ja toteutat älykkäitä ratkaisuja hyödyntäen generatiivista tekoälyä, agenttipohjaisia arkkitehtuureja ja uusimpia menetelmiä. Pilvipohjaisten LLM- ja koneoppimisalustojen rakentamista ja mallien käyttöönottoa julkipilvialustoilla, kuten Azure, AWS tai GCP
MLOpsin ja CI/CD-putkien suunnittelua ja toteutusta
Konsultointia ja teknistä sparrailua asiakkaiden kanssa – usein lähellä liiketoimintaa ja päätöksentekoa

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Start your software development career building real products used by professionals around the world.

Are you about to finish – or have you recently finished – your Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field?

At Dalux, you will join a product team where you can develop your technical skills while taking real responsibility from the the outset. You will work alongside experienced developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers to build software used across the global construction industry.

Your role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will work across our technology stack and take part in developing features end-to-end – from understanding the problem and designing a solution to implementation and delivery.

You will not be expected to know everything when you join.

Instead, we expect you to be curious, willing to learn, and ready to take increasing ownership as your skills develop. You will have experienced colleagues around you for daily technical sparring, code reviews, and support.

Your work will include:

Designing and developing new product functionality
Working across both front-end and back-end technologies
Collaborating with developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers
Writing maintainable, reliable, and high-quality software
Learning our products, architecture, and engineering practices
Taking increasing ownership of features and technical decisions as you develop
Contributing ideas for how we can improve our products and the way we build them

Developing software with AI

AI-assisted development is becoming an increasingly important part of how we build software at Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can help developers understand code, explore solutions, implement and refactor functionality, create tests, debug problems, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to be an AI expert. But we are looking for developers who are curious about these tools, willing to experiment, and able to think critically about when AI improves a solution – and when it does not.

If you have already experimented with AI-assisted development through your studies, student job, personal projects, or other work, we would be interested to hear what you learned.

Technologies we work with

Our main full-stack technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You are not expected to know our entire stack when you join. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

You will work in a product team together with a Product Manager and Product Designer, combining different perspectives on user value, usability, technical feasibility, and business viability.

This means understanding why we build something, contributing to how we solve the problem, and seeing your work become part of a product used by professionals worldwide.

We work according to agile principles and maintain a strong focus on quality, stability, and long-term maintainability.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have, or are about to complete, a Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a similar technical field
Have a solid foundation in software development and computer science
Are curious and motivated to learn new technologies
Enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work
Care about building good software, not simply making code compile
Are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and challenging yourself
Want to take ownership and responsibility as your skills grow

Professional experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What matters most is your technical potential, curiosity, interest in software craftsmanship, and willingness to learn.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to what we do.

You can expect:

Meaningful product responsibility early in your career
Daily sparring with skilled and experienced developers
Short paths between ideas, technical decisions, and implementation
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
Close collaboration with Product Management and Design
The opportunity to learn how AI-assisted development is changing software engineering

All our software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. We believe working together makes learning, technical collaboration, and knowledge sharing significantly easier – particularly at the beginning of your career.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house at Dalux.
