jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
jobs.location: Brøndby Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

Om jobbet

Som .NET-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C# og moderne .NET
Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
Sikre fremdrift i app-teamet med mock-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
Bruge moderne AI-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

Dyb .NET-ekspertise: Du er en stærk håndværker i C# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
Frontend-empati: Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
Pragmatisk fremdrift: Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
Agentic AI-kompetence: Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode- og udviklingsproces.
Product Engineer-mindset: Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

Om Product Engineering

Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in-house app-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.

Som backend-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Til glæde og til gavn

Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. I 2024 betød det hele 1,8 milliarder til idræt, kultur og foreningsliv i Danmark - og 3,28 milliarder i samlet samfundsbidrag.

Hvert år spiller mere end 1,9 millioner danskere hos os – online eller hos en af vores 3.700 forhandlere. Og vi er knap 500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med at balancere konkurrencedygtighed og ansvarlighed. For vi er hele Danmarks spilleselskab – til glæde og til gavn

jobs.description:
I Domestic Payment Capturing har vi ansvaret for brugeroplevelsen og de services, der gør det muligt at oprette indlandsbetalinger sikkert, stabilt og effektivt for både privat og erhverv.

Det er et område med stor betydning for både brugere, banker og forretning og med mange spændende tekniske og domænemæssige problemstillinger.

Rollen: Byg robuste services med fokus på både kode, brugere og drift

Som Senior Backend Developer bliver du en del af teamet bag oprettelse af indlandsbetalinger. Du kommer til at udvikle API’er, arbejde med test, vedligeholde eksisterende kode og bidrage til nyudvikling af moderne services i et agilt setup.

Du indgår i en rolle, hvor du både løser opgaver på egen hånd og samarbejder tæt med andre. Du er med til at planlægge og eksekvere opgaver i sprint, bryde større problemstillinger ned i mindre leverancer og skabe fremdrift på en måde, hvor teamet kan følge med, bidrage og bygge videre.

En vigtig del af rollen er at bidrage til høj kvalitet gennem clean code, automatisering af test og drift samt en god forståelse for security, compliance, observability og robusthed. Du er også med til at udvikle teamets arbejde med Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Design og moderne servicearkitektur.

Hvordan succes ser ud efter 6–12 måneder

Efter 6–12 måneder har du opbygget en solid forståelse for betalingsdomænet og kan finde rundt i centrale data, flows og afhængigheder:

Du leverer på udviklingsopgaver og bidrager i refinement, reviews, retrospectives og teamets løbende prioriteringer.
Du hjælper med at omsætte komplekse behov til tekniske løsninger, der kan udvikles, testes og releases sikkert.
Du gør risici, afhængigheder og usikkerheder synlige i tide og bidrager med forslag til, hvordan teamet kan håndtere dem.
Du bidrager også til teamets arbejde med DDD og moderne serviceudvikling – både gennem kode, sparring, reviews og konkrete forbedringsforslag.

Succes handler ikke om at kende alt fra start, men om at lære domænet, dele viden og skabe værdi sammen med teamet.

Teamet: Et engageret fagligt fællesskab, hvor viden deles åbent

Du bliver en del af Domestic Payment Capturing, et team på 14 personer med høj faglighed og dyb domæneviden: en Product Owner, to forretningskonsulenter, ti softwareudviklere og en manager.

Vi arbejder i et agilt setup inspireret af Scrum med to-ugers sprint, daglige standups og faste ceremonier. Hverdagen er præget af tæt samarbejde, åben sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne bliver komplekse. Det er helt forventeligt at stille spørgsmål, dele synspunkter og udfordre løsninger på en respektfuld måde – både i hverdagen og i forbindelse med reviews og retrospectives.

Som seniorprofil bidrager du ikke kun med kode, men også med ro, overblik og faglig sparring. Du kommunikerer tekniske emner klart til både udviklere, forretningskolleger og andre interessenter, og du hjælper med at skabe en arbejdsform, hvor flere kan bidrage og løfte nye opgaver.

Teamet har p.t. faste hjemmearbejdsdage tirsdag og fredag og arbejder fleksibelt, når hverdagen kræver det.

Profilen vi søger: Solid backend-erfaring og lyst til at udvikle andre

Du har mindst fem års professionel erfaring som softwareudvikler og en relevant baggrund som eksempelvis datalog, softwareingeniør eller datamatiker.
Du har solid erfaring med Spring Boot eller andet OOP som C#/.NET, Node.js eller lignend.
Du har praktisk erfaring med API-design, test og værktøjer som Postman eller Insomnia.
Du arbejder med CI/CD, automatisering og kvalitet som en naturlig del af udviklingsprocessen.
Derudover ser vi, at du har arbejdet med microservices, observability og drift af services i et komplekst miljø - og måske også haft de første erfaringer med Agentic AI.

Som person er du nysgerrig, omhyggelig og motiveret af at skabe løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at forstå både teknik, brugerbehov og forretningsmæssig kontekst, og du deler gerne din viden, så andre kan bygge videre på den. Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære, stille gode spørgsmål og bidrage til fælles tekniske valg.

Udviklingsmuligheder: Fordyb dig i komplekse systemer og moderne arkitektur

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i et komplekst betalingsdomæne med store datamængder, høj samfundsmæssig relevans og tydelige krav til kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabilitet.

Du får mulighed for at tage ansvar for egne services og produkter og fordybe dig fagligt inden for moderne backendudvikling, cloud, eventbaseret arkitektur, DDD, observability og automatisering.

Du får også mulighed for at påvirke teamets tekniske retning og bidrage til best practices i et område med mange nye opgaver og høj ledelsesmæssig opmærksomhed.

Klar til at være med til at forme indlandsbetalinger?

Har du lyst til at bruge din backend-erfaring til at bygge robuste services, dele viden og bidrage til et team, der lykkes sammen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1000 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her
.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO
is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers
each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod
to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code
Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase
Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality
Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems
Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game
Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android
Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month
, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months
, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months
, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Build the operational applications that power the future of intelligent manufacturing.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop modern operational applications that transform how work is performed across our global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain intuitive digital applications that empower operators, engineers, technicians, supervisors, and manufacturing leaders with real-time access to information, workflows, and intelligent decision support.

Your solutions will extend enterprise capabilities beyond traditional desktop applications by delivering secure, connected, and user-centric operational experiences across mobile devices, tablets, industrial workstations, and other frontline technologies.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Operational Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Enterprise KPI Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Operational excellence depends on providing the right information to the right people at the right time.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will develop applications that connect frontline employees with enterprise systems, operational data, and intelligent services. Whether supporting manufacturing execution, quality inspections, maintenance activities, warehouse operations, engineering workflows, or operational approvals, your applications will help simplify work and improve decision-making across Agilent's manufacturing network.

You'll work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and intuitive operational applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms, AI capabilities, and Smart Factory technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Application Development

Design, develop, and maintain modern operational applications that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, engineering, warehouse, logistics, and operational workflows.
Build intuitive applications that improve productivity, simplify frontline activities, and enhance user experience.
Develop reusable application components that accelerate delivery across multiple operational solutions.
Ensure applications are responsive, secure, accessible, and optimized for operational environments.

Workforce Productivity Solutions

Develop digital work instructions, operational checklists, inspection applications, maintenance workflows, inventory transactions, approvals, and task management solutions.
Deliver intuitive user experiences that reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
Support offline capabilities and reliable synchronization where network connectivity may be limited.
Design solutions that enable users to complete operational tasks efficiently across various devices.

Enterprise Integration

Integrate operational applications with enterprise platforms including SAP, MES, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and backend APIs.
Collaborate with Platform Engineers to consume secure enterprise services.
Work with Data Engineers to deliver trusted operational information.
Embed AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent recommendations, conversational assistants, and contextual insights into operational workflows.

User Experience & Adoption

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and user needs.
Design simple, intuitive workflows that improve adoption and reduce training effort.
Continuously enhance application usability through user feedback and iterative improvements.
Promote consistent user experience across operational applications.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

Evaluate emerging technologies that improve operational productivity, including enterprise mobility, wearable devices, barcode and QR technologies, camera integration, voice interaction, and AI-assisted user experiences.
Prototype innovative digital capabilities that enhance frontline operations and operational efficiency.
Contribute to Agilent's long-term Operational Applications strategy by identifying opportunities to simplify work through technology.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence teams to understand operational requirements and deliver practical digital solutions.
Collaborate closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Smart Factory Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to develop integrated enterprise applications.
Participate in Agile development, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technology Environment

You'll have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

Application Development

Flutter
React Native
.NET MAUI
React
TypeScript

C#

Required Qualifications

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

You should have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mobile Computing, or a related discipline.
Experience developing enterprise applications using modern web, mobile, or cross-platform technologies.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and enterprise application integration.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Passion for building digital solutions that improve operational efficiency and user productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

Flutter, React Native, .NET MAUI, or other cross-platform development frameworks.
Enterprise mobility and offline-first application development.
User-centered design and operational workflow optimization.
Manufacturing, warehouse, supply chain, or industrial applications.

AvePoint is a global leader in data management and data governance, and over 21,000 customers worldwide rely on our solutions to modernize the digital workplace across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce and other collaboration environments. .

At AvePoint, we are committed to investing in our people. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!

About The Role:

As a Cloud Developer
, you will create, maintain, and support shared application code libraries and common services managed by the Application and Architecture Engineering Team. You will resolve technical challenges faced by application teams through Proof of Concept, AWS Technical Support, or the internal Cloud Infrastructure team. You will collaborate with the application team, cloud team, and vendors for application migration or implementation in AWS Government Commercial Cloud (GCC).

Support the creation, maintenance and execution of Terraform Infrastructure as Code for applications.
Implementation and configuration of Cloud Services.
Solution the design and develop the software using Agile methodology.
Perform investigation, troubleshoot issues by developing scripts, SQL queries.
Work closely and collaborate with the Business Analysts and Quality Engineers/application testers for user stories elaboration, test automation, bug fixes etc.

Provide estimates for stories during sprint planning for Agile project.
Convert acceptance criteria into automated unit tests cases.
Support production issues and duty rotation for after-office-hours support
Champion Agile technical practices such as test-driven development, pair programming and refactoring
Involve in application deployment to the various environments.

Relevant software development certifications, e.g. AWS Certified Developer or equivalent.
Certified Software Testing Professional and/or Certified Software Quality Analyst or an equivalent certification will be an added advantage.
Good understanding and completion of projects using Agile methodology.
Demonstrable skills in Java, Dot Net, Javascript, Typescript, Python or Cloud development.

Familiar with application tracing or observability tools such as OpenTelemetry
Demonstrate knowledge of creating packaging / build scripts with Maven, Docker etc.
Ability to troubleshoot complex issues ranging from system resource to application stack traces.
Track record in implementing systems with high availability, high performance, high security hosted at various data centres or hybrid cloud environments will be an added advantage.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Mission:

The DevOps Engineer will maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. This role is responsible for supporting development stacks in Java and .NET, automating deployment pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, optimizing system performance, and ensuring reliability through robust monitoring and incident response practices. Working closely with development, platform, and DBA teams, the engineer will enable efficient CI/CD workflows, container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and database performance optimization for relational database systems (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL). The role also drives continuous improvement by adopting cloud-native technologies, enhancing security and compliance standards, and promoting DevOps best practices across the organization.

Accountabilities:

Maintain scalable, secure AWS infrastructure supporting diverse application stacks and database engines.
Support software development teams by integrating Java and .NET build, test, and release processes into automated delivery pipelines.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to enable reliable and automated deployments.
Implement and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., EKS).
Monitor, analyze, and fine-tune database performance, query execution plans, and resource utilization across enterprise database platforms (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Ensure high availability, rapid incident response, and continuous optimization of cloud and database workloads.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve automation, software delivery, database optimization, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

Manage application build and deployment lifecycles for Java and .NET applications.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment.
Provision and manage AWS infrastructure and managed database services.
Analyze slow queries, review execution plans, and implement performance fine-tuning strategies (e.g., indexing, query refactoring, table partitioning, parameter group tuning) for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring proper runtime configuration for JVM memory and .NET application environments.
Monitor system and database performance, troubleshooting bottlenecks, high CPU/memory utilization, and connection pooling issues to ensure maximum availability.
Implement and enforce security, access control, backup/recovery strategies, and operational best practices across dev, test, and production environments.

Team Scope / Stakeholders:

Collaborate with Java and .NET Software Engineering teams to streamline build configurations, application packaging, and release workflows.
Work with Database Administration (DBA) teams to optimize SQL queries, improve database performance, and enable efficient release processes.
Partner with Cloud/Platform Engineering to design and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure.
Work closely with QA and Testing teams to integrate automated performance and integration testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Engage with Security teams to ensure compliance with security policies, database access control, and data protection standards.
Support Product Owners and Business stakeholders by ensuring reliable, high-performing, and timely delivery of applications and services.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or database reliability roles.

Programming & Development Skills:

Strong knowledge of Java development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., Maven, Gradle, JVM tuning).
Strong knowledge of .NET / C# development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., .NET CLI, MSBuild, .NET Core / .NET 6+).
Proficiency in scripting and operational programming (e.g., Python, Bash, Shell) for automation.
Proficient in writing, debugging, and optimizing complex SQL queries.

Cloud, DevOps & Database Skills:

Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS).
Strong experience in CI/CD tools, particularly Jenkins, and version control systems (e.g., Git).
Strong experience in relational database query optimization and performance fine-tuning for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL (e.g., execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, deadlocks, lock escalation, buffer pool usage).
Proficiency in database performance monitoring tools (e.g., AWS RDS Performance Insights, Oracle AWR/ADDM, SQL Server Execution Plans/Profiler, PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE / pg_stat_statements).
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with application and infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
Proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems, diagnose performance bottlenecks, and work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

At #TeamCPF, you’re not just joining a team; you are embracing a culture of excellence, collaboration, and meaningful impact. You will play a pivotal role in empowering over 4 million members to secure their retirement, healthcare, housing needs and better navigate life’s uncertainties.

Gain hands-on experience in cloud application development and deployment using AWS cloud services.
Work with containerisation and cloud technologies to support scalable, resilient, and secure application architectures.
Participate in Agile software delivery practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and automated testing to ensure the quality and reliability of applications.
Support troubleshooting, defect analysis, root cause investigation, and implementation of fixes for application issues.
Contribute to the design, implementation, and enhancement of CI/CD pipelines to improve development efficiency, deployment reliability, and software quality.
Develop automation scripts, tools, and monitoring capabilities to improve operational efficiency and system observability.
Apply software engineering best practices, including code reviews, secure coding principles, and application performance optimisation.

Explore and recommend innovative approaches to improve application functionality, user experience, scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

Currently pursuing a Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.title: Optical Manufacturing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Overview

As an Optical Manufacturing Automation Engineer
, you will play a critical role in developing and scaling the automation infrastructure that supports the manufacturing of Lumilens’ next-generation silicon photonics and optical transceiver products. This role sits at the intersection of manufacturing, test engineering, software development, and data analytics, with responsibility for designing, deploying, and optimizing automated production systems that improve throughput, yield, quality, and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with manufacturing, process engineering, optical design, quality, and software teams to develop automated test and manufacturing solutions that support both new product introduction (NPI) and high-volume production. The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience with optical manufacturing environments and strong software development capabilities, enabling the creation of robust automation frameworks, equipment integration solutions, manufacturing data systems, and intelligent workflows that accelerate production scale-up and continuous improvement.

Duties/Responsibilities

Develop and implement automation solutions that support optical transceiver, silicon photonics, and advanced packaging manufacturing processes from prototype through high-volume production.
Design, develop, and maintain software applications, automation frameworks, and control systems used for manufacturing equipment, test stations, calibration systems, and process monitoring.
Integrate manufacturing equipment, optical test systems, robotics, motion control platforms, and factory automation tools using standard communication protocols and software interfaces.
Partner with manufacturing, process, and test engineering teams to automate manual production activities, improve cycle time, reduce operator dependency, and enhance process repeatability.
Develop automated workflows for data collection, traceability, process control, and production reporting across manufacturing operations.
Create and maintain software tools that support manufacturing execution, equipment monitoring, yield analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and production performance tracking.
Lead automation efforts supporting new product introduction (NPI), ensuring manufacturing systems, test platforms, and process controls are production-ready at launch.
Collaborate with quality and engineering teams to implement automated validation, calibration, and qualification processes that improve product quality and manufacturing consistency.
Develop dashboards, reporting tools, and analytics solutions that provide visibility into manufacturing performance, equipment utilization, yield trends, and operational bottlenecks.
Ensure all manufacturing automation software follows established quality management system (QMS) requirements, including version control, change management, documentation, validation, and release procedures.
Support troubleshooting and root cause investigations related to manufacturing equipment, automation systems, test stations, and production software.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, factory digitization, throughput optimization, yield improvement, and cost reduction.
Collaborate with software engineers, IT teams, database architects, and manufacturing leaders to define scalable automation architectures that support future manufacturing growth.
Generate technical documentation, operating procedures, validation plans, and training materials supporting manufacturing automation systems.

SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field with 7+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing automation, test automation, or industrial software development.
Experience supporting optical transceiver, silicon photonics, semiconductor, advanced packaging, or high-volume electronics manufacturing environments.
Strong software development experience using Python, C#, C++, LabVIEW, or similar languages for manufacturing automation and equipment integration.
Experience developing software interfaces for manufacturing equipment, automated test systems, robotics, motion control platforms, and production hardware.
Strong understanding of manufacturing automation architectures, industrial communication protocols, and equipment integration methodologies.
Hands-on experience with manufacturing data systems, database development, and production analytics using SQL, NoSQL, or equivalent technologies.
Experience implementing automated data collection, process monitoring, statistical process control (SPC), yield analysis, and reporting solutions.
Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), ERP systems, factory automation platforms, and production traceability requirements.
Experience with source code management and software lifecycle processes using GitHub, Bitbucket, SVN, or similar version control tools.
Strong understanding of software quality practices including validation, regression testing, release management, bug tracking, and change control.
Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing scale-up, and production ramp activities.
Knowledge of optical manufacturing processes, transceiver assembly, silicon photonics production, automated optical alignment, calibration systems, or high-speed optical testing is highly desirable.
Understanding of quality systems, reliability requirements, and manufacturing compliance standards.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling manufacturing environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
International travel may be required.

jobs.title: AVP/VP, Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration), Technology Group
jobs.description:
About GIC

GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Technology Group

We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new and emerging technologies.

Strategy, Architecture, and Transformation Group

The Strategy, Architecture & Transformation (SAT) group shapes and drives GIC’s technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enterprise goals. Bringing together expertise in strategy, architecture, engineering, and transformation, the team strengthens governance, promotes consistency, and accelerates delivery across the Technology Group. Through modern practices and close collaboration, SAT leads the development of an architectural strategy that reinforces oversight and accountability while enabling reliable, scalable solutions and informed decision making across the Technology Group and, more broadly, across GIC.

Developer Experience

The Developer Experience team builds and operates the products and platforms that support the developer experience across GIC's Technology Group. The team is organised around three product pillars:

Project Management Tooling — Platforms such as Jira and Confluence that support project tracking, collaboration, and workflow management across the Technology Group.
Cloud Development Environments & IDEs — Cloud-based development environments, AI-assisted coding tools, developer toolchains (CLIs, SDKs, IDE extensions, devcontainer features), and agentic development capabilities.
DevSecOps & CI/CD — CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, security scanning integration, infrastructure-as-code, and secure software delivery tooling.

What impact can you make in this role?

As a Product Engineer responsible for Developer Acceleration, you will build and operate the infrastructure that enables hundreds of employees to be productive through our agentic cloud development platform. By joining this team, you will have a direct impact on the velocity and quality of software engineering at GIC. You will evolve our agentic cloud development platform, shape the next generation of the agentic SDLC, and transform how software is built and delivered across GIC.

You are a platform engineer who is also an AI-native developer: you use coding agents as core engineering tools across specification, design, implementation, testing, and review, while applying sound engineering judgement and remaining accountable for the quality, security, and operability of the software you ship.

What will you do as a Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration)?

You will work across three connected areas: platform and infrastructure engineering, developer tooling and governance, and AI-native development and agent enablement.
Operate and evolve the agentic cloud development platform, covering infrastructure, networking, deployment automation, devcontainer lifecycle, observability, security, and governance.
Address developer needs, resolve platform issues, and build processes and integrations that connect the platform with enterprise development services and systems.
Govern the developer tools estate — evaluate, onboard, secure, and manage the lifecycle of IDEs, extensions, SDKs, CLIs, and AI coding tools through clear guardrails and paved paths.
Drive AI-native development across GIC — establish reusable practices, context engineering, MCP integrations, and reference workflows, and provide clear guidance and enablement to accelerate adoption across teams.
Build and integrate the agentic SDLC platform — develop agent execution and human review workflows that connect project management tools, source control, and CI/CD to enable end-to-end delivery.
Collaborate with infra and security teams to ensure platform capabilities meet requirements for observability, resilience, and compliance.

What makes you a successful candidate?

Experience
6+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including hands-on ownership of developer platforms or large-scale distributed systems in production.
2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives as an engineer or technical lead.
Strong programming proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong AWS expertise, including EC2, VPC networking, IAM, EKS or ECS, CloudWatch, and S3.
Strong experience with infrastructure as code and automation using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
Deep familiarity with containerised development, including devcontainers, image build pipelines, and dependency management.
Security-first engineering experience covering network segmentation, least-privilege access, and operation in regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated AI-native development practice — hands-on use of coding agents across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to recognise their limitations and validate AI-generated code before release.
Clear technical communication — able to write guidance, run enablement sessions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Product & Delivery Mindset
Demonstrated ability to think about engineering work through a product lens — understanding users, measuring outcomes, and iterating based on feedback.
Comfortable owning a product backlog and making prioritisation decisions.
Experience working in agile teams with a focus on incremental delivery.

Governance & Ways of Working
Ability to balance developer experience and autonomy with enterprise requirements for security, standardisation, and cost control.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams.
Comfortable navigating competing priorities and driving alignment.

Personal Attributes
Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal.
Pragmatic, structured, and outcome-focused.
Consistently demonstrates GIC's PRIME values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit, and Excellence.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Learn more about our Technology Group here:

https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/
Our PRIME Values

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery

Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all .

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

Responsibilities

Decompose end-to-end processes: Map current-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
Architect the agentic solution: Build future-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data-classification standards.
Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
Engineer trust and control: Define testable human-in-the-loop controls and least-privilege permissions for each process step.
Drive multi-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90-day post-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
Agentic Delivery: 8+ years of overall experience and 3+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi-agent development, context management, and long-horizon tasks.
Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

Suvoda is a global clinical trial technology company shaping digital experiences that enable clinical trial sponsor and site professionals to take full command over the inherent logistical complexity behind mission-critical and time-sensitive patient interactions in life-sustaining studies for therapeutic areas such as oncology, central nervous system, and rare disease.

Supporting clinical trials means supporting unique experiments that are inherently complex, high-stakes, and dynamic. It is imperative that Suvoda staff working with clients, end-users, or the systems that client and end-users interact with understand the clinical trial industry, regulations, Suvoda’s software products and processes, and especially the specificities of the unique trial in question before taking any actions they may alter the data of the system in question.

Review user requirements specifications, verifying that all requirements can be implemented with the Suvoda software in the required timeframe
Assist with the creation of implementation design and technical design documentation
Develop software systems that are reliable, maintainable, and efficient, with emphasis on patient safety and integrity of clinical study data
Manage the deployment of Suvoda IRT systems into all environments, completing all required documentation
Assist the support team with troubleshooting and resolution of issues reported on production systems
Participate in the product research and development process by providing the engineering team with new solutions and ideas based on project experience
Generate ideas for innovative technological solutions to increase the quality of Suvoda system
Perform other related duties as required

Bachelor’s degree preferred
At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
Prior working experience in developing web applications with C#, .NET (Framework or Core), SQL Server, Model View Controller (MVC) and Entity Framework (EF)
High achieving personality
Desire to learn and grow
Strong work ethic
Sense of ownership
Proactive attitude
Time management and organizational skills
Attention to detail

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

About the Role:

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.

In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high-availability cloud APIs.

What you’ll be doing:

Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux

Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals

Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences

Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development

Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus

Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access

Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases

Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers

Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day

We’re looking for:

7-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or  Linux applications (including integration with third-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must

Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes

Strong hands-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must

Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C++ would be an added advantage

Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage

Willingness to mentor junior members of the team

Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role. 

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

The Senior Software Architect is a senior technical leadership role within the iGaming Platform team. This is not a "heads-down coding" role, nor is it a purely advisory one — it sits at the intersection of hands-on delivery and architectural ownership. You will be expected to make and defend design decisions, lead cross-team technical alignment, and ensure the platform scales, integrates, and operates reliably at global scale.

Contribute to the Tech Atlas, Asset Registry, and governance artefacts that underpin L&W's architecture practice
Lead threat modelling exercises using structured approaches (STRIDE, Threagile) and translate outcomes into actionable security requirements

Design and evolve RESTful and event-driven APIs using OpenAPI specifications, establishing contracts that support independent team delivery
Architect integrations with third-party systems including payment providers, identity services, regulatory reporting endpoints, and operator platforms
Provide technical governance over CI/CD pipeline design, environment architecture, and deployment strategies using GitHub Actions, Kustomize, and ArgoCD
Hands-on prototyping and proof-of-concept development when needed to de-risk architectural decisions

Engineering Quality & Standards

Define and champion non-functional standards: performance baselines, resilience patterns, observability requirements, and security controls
Lead or contribute to performance and load testing design, interpreting results in the context of SLAs and platform growth targets
Establish and evolve coding and integration standards across Java/Spring services on the platform

Collaboration & Influence

Strong Java/Spring Boot background with demonstrable experience designing cloud-native microservices at scale
Experience designing and operating event-driven systems using Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms

Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (gaming, fintech, payments, or similar)
